say:4:1711111003:1.male: Congratulations! You're now an honorary member of <style="highlight">The Society for the Eternal Glory of King Rolan</style>! Together, we shall spread his glory across the land!
say:4:1711111003:1.female: Congratulations! You're now an honorary member of <style="highlight">The Society for the Eternal Glory of King Rolan</style>! Together, we shall spread his glory across the land!

say:5:1711111004:0.text: We're family now, so there are no secrets. What do you need? If it's intel on King Rolan, we've got you covered.
say:5:1711111004:0.source_cn: 作为家人，我们绝不藏私！你想问什么？只要是关于大帝的情...
say:5:1711111004:0.male: We're family now, so there are no secrets. What do you need? If it's intel on King Rolan, we've got you covered.
say:5:1711111004:0.female: We're family now, so there are no secrets. What do you need? If it's intel on King Rolan, we've got you covered.

choice_prompt:6:1711111004.text: We're family now, so there are no secrets. What do you need? If it's intel on King Rolan, we've got you covered.
choice_prompt:6:1711111004.source_cn: 作为家人，我们绝不藏私！你想问什么？只要是关于大帝的情报，我们知无不言！
choice_prompt:6:1711111004.male: We're family now, so there are no secrets. What do you need? If it's intel on King Rolan, we've got you covered.
choice_prompt:6:1711111004.female: We're family now, so there are no secrets. What do you need? If it's intel on King Rolan, we've got you covered.

say:7:1711111005:1.text: Ah... Don't we all? To witness that magnificent presence with one's own eyes is every follower's dream. Still, for a fellow member, we'll share what we know.
say:7:1711111005:1.source_cn: 噢……每个人都想亲眼目睹那份尊荣，但这需要极高的缘分！...
say:7:1711111005:1.male: Ah... Don't we all? To witness that magnificent presence with one's own eyes is every follower's dream. Still, for a fellow member, we'll share what we know.
say:7:1711111005:1.female: Ah... Don't we all? To witness that magnificent presence with one's own eyes is every follower's dream. Still, for a fellow member, we'll share what we know.

say:8:1711111006:1.text: According to our informants, there have been recent sightings of a majestic fox.
say:8:1711111006:1.source_cn: 据守护会潜伏在全城的眼线汇报，近期有三个地方出现了疑似...
say:8:1711111006:1.male: According to our informants, there have been recent sightings of a majestic fox.
say:8:1711111006:1.female: According to our informants, there have been recent sightings of a majestic fox.

choice_prompt:9:1711111006.text: According to our informants, there have been recent sightings of a majestic fox.
choice_prompt:9:1711111006.source_cn: 据守护会潜伏在全城的眼线汇报，近期有三个地方出现了疑似大帝……咳，那只高贵狐狸的踪迹。
choice_prompt:9:1711111006.male: According to our informants, there have been recent sightings of a majestic fox.
choice_prompt:9:1711111006.female: According to our informants, there have been recent sightings of a majestic fox.

say:10:1711111007:0.text: First up, the Lionheart Hunting Grounds! That place is a royal domain. The King must be revisiting his old haunts, reminiscing about his glorious hunting days!
say:10:1711111007:0.source_cn: 首先是狮心猎场！那里是王室御用之地，大帝一定是在故地重...
say:10:1711111007:0.male: First up, the Lionheart Hunting Grounds! That place is a royal domain. The King must be revisiting his old haunts, reminiscing about his glorious hunting days!
say:10:1711111007:0.female: First up, the Lionheart Hunting Grounds! That place is a royal domain. The King must be revisiting his old haunts, reminiscing about his glorious hunting days!

say:11:1711111008:1.text: Second is Rusty Barrel Tavern. Someone spotted him lurking around the kitchen. He must have been traveling incognito to better understand the lives of his people!
say:11:1711111008:1.source_cn: 其次是锈桶酒馆，有人目击他在后厨附近徘徊。那一定是在微...
say:11:1711111008:1.male: Second is Rusty Barrel Tavern. Someone spotted him lurking around the kitchen. He must have been traveling incognito to better understand the lives of his people!
say:11:1711111008:1.female: Second is Rusty Barrel Tavern. Someone spotted him lurking around the kitchen. He must have been traveling incognito to better understand the lives of his people!

say:12:1711111009:1.text: Finally, the riverbank in the upper district. People reported seeing him there, staring into the water. He must have been pondering the fate of the Empire!
say:12:1711111009:1.source_cn: 最后是上城区的河道边，经常有人看到他在那里发呆。
say:12:1711111009:1.male: Finally, the riverbank in the upper district. People reported seeing him there, staring into the water. He must have been pondering the fate of the Empire!
say:12:1711111009:1.female: Finally, the riverbank in the upper district. People reported seeing him there, staring into the water. He must have been pondering the fate of the Empire!

say:13:1711111010:0.text: Ah... What a lonely, profound, and captivating figure he must have cut...
say:13:1711111010:0.source_cn: 那一定是在忧国忧民，看着流淌的河水思考耀光的未来……啊...

say:14:1711111011:1.text: In any case, he comes and goes like the wind. Whether you actually catch him depends on luck.
say:14:1711111011:1.source_cn: 总之，罗兰大帝行踪如风，能不能见到他，全凭你的运气了。
say:14:1711111011:1.male: In any case, he comes and goes like the wind. Whether you actually catch him depends on luck.
say:14:1711111011:1.female: In any case, he comes and goes like the wind. Whether you actually catch him depends on luck.

say:0:1711112001:0.text: Guess I've got three places to investigate.
say:0:1711112001:0.source_cn: 那就逐一调查狮心猎场、锈桶酒馆和上城区的河道吧。
say:0:1711112001:0.male: Guess I've got three places to investigate.
say:0:1711112001:0.female: Guess I've got three places to investigate.

say:0:1711127001:1.text: The intel from the Society was false. Three locations with no results.
say:0:1711127001:1.source_cn: 罗兰大帝永恒荣耀守护会的情报并不靠谱，你找了三个地方却...
say:0:1711127001:1.male: The intel from the Society was false. Three locations with no results.
say:0:1711127001:1.female: The intel from the Society was false. Three locations with no results.

say:1:1711127002:1.text: Looks like you'll have to figure this out yourself... Maybe there's somewhere else to look.
say:1:1711127002:1.source_cn: 看来只能自己想办法了……或许，能去别的地方碰碰运气？
say:1:1711127002:1.male: Looks like you'll have to figure this out yourself... Maybe there's somewhere else to look.
say:1:1711127002:1.female: Looks like you'll have to figure this out yourself... Maybe there's somewhere else to look.

say:2:1711127003:1.text: Somewhere only the two of you would know... Maybe the Fortress Council?
say:2:1711127003:1.source_cn: 比如，一个只有你们两个人才知道的地方——坚壁议事厅。
say:2:1711127003:1.male: Somewhere only the two of you would know... Maybe the Fortress Council?
say:2:1711127003:1.female: Somewhere only the two of you would know... Maybe the Fortress Council?

say:1:1711130001:1.text: Roast chicken, foie gras, caviar, and aged wine? Don't tell me you raided a noble's kitchen just to track me down?
say:1:1711130001:1.source_cn: 烤鸡、鹅肝、鱼子酱，还有陈酿？看来你不仅成功追踪到了我...
say:1:1711130001:1.male: Roast chicken, foie gras, caviar, and aged wine? Don't tell me you raided a noble's kitchen just to track me down?
say:1:1711130001:1.female: Roast chicken, foie gras, caviar, and aged wine? Don't tell me you raided a noble's kitchen just to track me down?

say:2:1711130002:1.text: You explain that his reputation has caused a massive fox-worshiping craze in the capital, and one grateful fox insisted on sending this tribute.
say:2:1711130002:1.source_cn: 你无奈地告诉了小狐狸，这是因为他英勇“救国”，从而带起...
say:2:1711130002:1.male: You explain that his reputation has caused a massive fox-worshiping craze in the capital, and one grateful fox insisted on sending this tribute.
say:2:1711130002:1.female: You explain that his reputation has caused a massive fox-worshiping craze in the capital, and one grateful fox insisted on sending this tribute.

say:3:1711130003:1.text: Exquisite! Who knew I'd raise the standard of living for the city's fox population? I truly am a saint.
say:3:1711130003:1.source_cn: 唔！味道真不错。真没想到，我居然还拉动了王都狐狸一族的...
say:3:1711130003:1.male: Exquisite! Who knew I'd raise the standard of living for the city's fox population? I truly am a saint.
say:3:1711130003:1.female: Exquisite! Who knew I'd raise the standard of living for the city's fox population? I truly am a saint.

choice_prompt:5:1711130003.text: Exquisite! Who knew I'd raise the standard of living for the city's fox population? I truly am a saint.
choice_prompt:5:1711130003.source_cn: 唔！味道真不错。真没想到，我居然还拉动了王都狐狸一族的整体生活水平。真是好事啊！
choice_prompt:5:1711130003.male: Exquisite! Who knew I'd raise the standard of living for the city's fox population? I truly am a saint.
choice_prompt:5:1711130003.female: Exquisite! Who knew I'd raise the standard of living for the city's fox population? I truly am a saint.

say:6:1711130004:1.text: I've been working hard for Savannah this whole time. You fail to see my hardships!
say:6:1711130004:1.source_cn: 我可是一直在为赛凡纳操劳，是你不理解我的辛苦。
say:6:1711130004:1.male: I've been working hard for Savannah this whole time. You fail to see my hardships!
say:6:1711130004:1.female: I've been working hard for Savannah this whole time. You fail to see my hardships!

say:7:1711130005:1.text: If people chased you everywhere you went, you'd probably hide even farther away than I did.
say:7:1711130005:1.source_cn: 要是你也像本狐似的，走到哪里都被一群人追赶，你肯定会躲...
say:7:1711130005:1.male: If people chased you everywhere you went, you'd probably hide even farther away than I did.
say:7:1711130005:1.female: If people chased you everywhere you went, you'd probably hide even farther away than I did.

say:8:1711130008:1.text: But enough about that. What did you come all this way to ask me?
say:8:1711130008:1.source_cn: 不过，你来找本狐是有什么事吗？总不能是为了献上点美食吧？
say:8:1711130008:1.male: But enough about that. What did you come all this way to ask me?
say:8:1711130008:1.female: But enough about that. What did you come all this way to ask me?

choice_prompt:9:1711130008.text: But enough about that. What did you come all this way to ask me?
choice_prompt:9:1711130008.source_cn: 不过，你来找本狐是有什么事吗？总不能是为了献上点美食吧？
choice_prompt:9:1711130008.male: But enough about that. What did you come all this way to ask me?
choice_prompt:9:1711130008.female: But enough about that. What did you come all this way to ask me?

say:10:1711130009:1.text: Ah. So you've already spoken with the Queen.
say:10:1711130009:1.source_cn: 哦？看来你去见过王后了。
say:10:1711130009:1.male: Ah. So you've already spoken with the Queen.
say:10:1711130009:1.female: Ah. So you've already spoken with the Queen.

say:11:1711130010:1.text: Hmm... Explaining this to someone who's lost their memories is a bit tricky.
say:11:1711130010:1.source_cn: 嗯……要和失忆的你解释这件事，稍微有点麻烦。
say:11:1711130010:1.male: Hmm... Explaining this to someone who's lost their memories is a bit tricky.
say:11:1711130010:1.female: Hmm... Explaining this to someone who's lost their memories is a bit tricky.

say:12:1711130011:1.text: Let's see... Where should I begin?
say:12:1711130011:1.source_cn: 让我想想，究竟该从何说起比较好——
say:12:1711130011:1.male: Let's see... Where should I begin?
say:12:1711130011:1.female: Let's see... Where should I begin?

say:14:1711130012:1.text: I hear the tolling of the bells... It's time.
say:14:1711130012:1.source_cn: 我听见了钟声……是时候了。

say:15:1711130013:1.text: After this long journey toward our destined day, we finally stand here together.
say:15:1711130013:1.source_cn: 罗兰，在这条通往命定之日的漫长征途中，我们终于并肩立于此地。

say:16:1711130014:1.text: It has been a long, bitter war, Goddess. I feel as though my very soul has nearly burned away.
say:16:1711130014:1.source_cn: 真是辛苦而漫长的一战啊……女神。我仿佛连灵魂都快要燃烧...

say:17:1711130015:1.text: To see you show such vulnerability... It reminds me that you are not an unyielding star fixed in the heavens.
say:17:1711130015:1.source_cn: 你偶尔展露出如此脆弱的姿态，倒是让我记起，你并非永恒不...

say:18:1711130016:1.text: But a mortal of warm flesh and blood. One who bleeds, and one who grows weary.
say:18:1711130016:1.source_cn: 而是一个有着温热血肉、会流血、也会感到疲惫的凡人。

say:19:1711130017:1.text: In the shadow of total ruin, is that a compliment to my resilience, or a sigh at my limitations?
say:19:1711130017:1.source_cn: 女神，在毁灭的阴影面前，您这是在称赞我作为凡人的顽强，...

say:20:1711130018:1.text: Even with a mighty foe before us, you still find room for humor beneath the weight of impending ruin. It seems the darkness has never managed to break your spirit.
say:20:1711130018:1.source_cn: 强敌已至，你还能在毁灭的威压下维持这份幽默，看来你的意...

say:21:1711130019:1.text: Good. That unyielding spirit is humanity's brightest light.
say:21:1711130019:1.source_cn: 很好，罗兰。这正是人类最耀眼的微光。

say:22:1711130020:1.text: Then, as a reward for the countless trials that brought you here, accept this gift—
say:22:1711130020:1.source_cn: 那么……作为你一路披荆斩棘、行至此处的勋章，收下这份助...

say:23:1711130021:1.text:
This sword is my will made manifest upon the mortal world.
This sword is the dawn that parts the endless night.
say:23:1711130021:1.source_cn: 此剑，即为我行走尘世的意志。\n此剑，即为我劈开长夜的曙光。

say:24:1711130022:1.text: Rolan, this sword carries the authority I entrust to you; the power to shape the future itself. Take it. It bears my blessing and my strength.
say:24:1711130022:1.source_cn: 罗兰啊，此剑，即为我赋予你裁断未来的权柄！拿起它，握紧...

say:26:1711130023:1.text: Doubt no longer, and pray no longer! Wherever this sword stands, I shall stand beside you. Wherever its blade is turned, there shall I crown your cause.
say:26:1711130023:1.source_cn: 无须迷茫，亦无须再向我祈祷！剑之所在，则我与你比肩，剑...

say:27:1711130024:1.text: I, Rolan Augusta, swear before the Goddess of Life—
say:27:1711130024:1.source_cn: 我，罗兰·奥古斯塔，在此向生命女神起誓——

say:28:1711130025:1.text: I shall wield this blade until my last drop of blood is spent. I shall make the nightmares of the abyss remember...
say:28:1711130025:1.source_cn: 我将挥舞此剑，直至流尽最后一滴血。我会让盘踞在深渊中的...

say:29:1711130026:1.text: So long as this blade remains unbroken, the flame of life in Esperia shall never die!
say:29:1711130026:1.source_cn: 只要此剑不断，伊索米亚的生命之火，便永不熄灭！

say:30:1711130027:0.text: Then go forth to battle, and shatter the shadows of the abyss!
say:30:1711130027:0.source_cn: 那么，去战斗吧，击败那些深渊之影！

choice:9:1:2.text: Why did you go see Gwendolyn?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你为什么去找了莫德琳？
choice:9:1:2.male: Why did you go see Gwendolyn?
choice:9:1:2.female: Why did you go see Gwendolyn?

choice:5:0:1.text: Can you please be serious for once...?
choice:5:0:1.male: Can you please be serious for once...?
choice:5:0:1.female: Can you please be serious for once...?

say:32:1711130006:1.text: I may not need food to exist, but I still respect the culinary arts.
say:32:1711130006:1.source_cn: 就算不需要食物也能维持存在，但我仍然尊重食欲。
say:32:1711130006:1.male: I may not need food to exist, but I still respect the culinary arts.
say:32:1711130006:1.female: I may not need food to exist, but I still respect the culinary arts.

say:33:1711130007:1.text: Fine dining is the pinnacle of mortal civilization. Eating keeps me connected to who I used to be.
say:33:1711130007:1.source_cn: 美食可是人类文明的缩影，吃东西会让我铭记自己原本的身份。
say:33:1711130007:1.male: Fine dining is the pinnacle of mortal civilization. Eating keeps me connected to who I used to be.
say:33:1711130007:1.female: Fine dining is the pinnacle of mortal civilization. Eating keeps me connected to who I used to be.

choice:5:1:2.text: You're really thinking about food right now?!
choice:5:1:2.male: You're really thinking about food right now?!
choice:5:1:2.female: You're really thinking about food right now?!

say:2:1711131001:1.text: It's over... The sky is free of shadow once more. Goddess, have we truly won?
say:2:1711131001:1.source_cn: 结束了……至少这一刻，天空不再被阴影遮蔽。女神，我们已...

say:3:1711131002:0.text: Look closer, Rolan. The dust may have settled, but the depths of Esperia still tremble.
say:3:1711131002:0.source_cn: 看啊，罗兰。尘埃虽已落定，但伊索米亚深处的震颤从未停歇...

say:4:1711131003:0.text: Our light has yet to reach the darkest corners below.
say:4:1711131003:0.source_cn: 那意图吞噬万物的恶意，依然盘踞在不可触及的深渊之底。

say:5:1711131004:0.text: Even now, it sharpens its claws in darkness, weaving the next black tide that could destroy Esperia.
say:5:1711131004:0.source_cn: 它在黑暗中磨砺爪牙，在静默中编织下一次足以毁灭伊索米亚...

say:6:1711131005:1.text: Then this bitter struggle is far from its end.
say:6:1711131005:1.source_cn: 看来这艰苦卓绝的抗争，还远远没有到谢幕的时候。

say:7:1711131006:0.text: This was always meant to be an endless crusade. But for now, we have earned a precious moment to breathe.
say:7:1711131006:0.source_cn: 这本就是一场永无止境的远征。但伊索米亚已经获得了最宝贵...

say:8:1711131007:0.text: Do not lower your guard, Rolan. Before the abyss fully awakens, build a kingdom strong enough to shield mortals. Let its light banish their fear...
say:8:1711131007:0.source_cn: 不要松懈，罗兰。在那深渊彻底苏醒前，去建立起足以守护凡...

narration:9:1711131008:1.text: Years passed. The Lightbearer Empire flourished and grew strong. Yet, the lifetime of a mortal is but a fleeting moment to a goddess.

say:10:1711131009:1.text: Rolan... it has been a long time.

say:11:1711131010:1.text: Goddess. You asked me to build a kingdom to protect mankind, and its foundations now stand firm. Yet it seems my journey is nearing its end.
say:11:1711131010:1.source_cn: 女神，您曾让我建立守护凡人的国度，如今它已初具轮廓。但...

say:12:1711131011:1.text: The sword that carries your will has grown too heavy. My mortal flesh can no longer wield it for this land.
say:12:1711131011:1.source_cn: 这柄承载着您意志的剑太过沉重。以我这具凡人之躯，已经无...

say:13:1711131012:1.text: And yet, with nothing but mortal flesh and blood, you accomplished a feat that even the gods regard with wonder. For that...
say:13:1711131012:1.source_cn: 你以凡人的血肉之躯，创造了连神明也为之侧目的奇迹。对此——

say:14:1711131013:1.text: In the name of the Goddess of Life, I invite you to step into eternity. Cast off your mortal shackles, ascend as a Celestial, and watch over the land you fought so hard to protect.
say:14:1711131013:1.source_cn: 我以生命女神之名，邀你踏入永恒的领域——褪去凡人的桎梏...

say:15:1711131014:1.text: If I were to follow my own selfish desires, I would ask to return to the earth now that my duty is done. But the Lightbearer Empire is still young...
say:15:1711131014:1.source_cn: 如果可以顺从私心，我本愿在使命终结后回归尘土。但耀光帝...

say:16:1711131015:1.text: If you are willing to grant me the privilege of guiding it from afar, I will accept this eternal burden.
say:16:1711131015:1.source_cn: 如果您愿意赋予我继续陪伴它的特权，我将接下这份永恒的责任。

say:17:1711131016:1.text: If you intend to guide the empire from afar, have you chosen who will inherit the throne?
say:17:1711131016:1.source_cn: 既然你将以半神的姿态隐于幕后，那么凡世的王座，你选好继...

say:18:1711131017:1.text: No. I refuse to make that choice.
say:18:1711131017:1.source_cn: 我拒绝行使这项权利，女神。

say:20:1711131019:1.text: Because I was once mortal, I know our greed, our shortsightedness, and our fickle nature. Mortals lack the vision of the divine. I cannot guarantee that the one I choose today will always make the right choice tomorrow.
say:20:1711131019:1.source_cn: 我终究是从凡人走来，我深知人类的贪婪、短视与多变。凡人...

say:21:1711131020:1.text: So I return this choice to you. To the immortal gods.
say:21:1711131020:1.source_cn: 所以，我将这个选择权交还给您，交还给不朽的神明。

say:22:1711131021:1.text: You are as cautious and wise as ever. Very well. We shall let <style="highlight">fate</style> decide.
say:22:1711131021:1.source_cn: 你总是这么谨慎而清醒。既然你不愿独断未来，那就让<st...

say:23:1711131022:1.text: Rolan, drive your sword into this stone.

document:1:573:0.text:
<style="stress">Kraff's Will</style>
To whom it may concern,

Unfortunately, I suffered a <style="highlight">high-tier arcane backlash</style> during an experiment, leaving my body severely corrupted. Pursuant to Article 3, Chapter 7 of the Magical Safety Regulations, my remains must be placed in a <style="highlight">triple-layered sealed coffin</style> to prevent the corruption from spreading to others.

Warning: Do not open the coffin or perform any purification rituals under any circumstances. Ignore this warning at your own peril.

Please ensure the personal belongings on my desk remain in their original state and are handed over to my next of kin.

Lastly, if you wish to pay your respects, please bring a bottle of golden amber wine and a slice of mille-feuille cake to my grave. Hopefully, they can... soothe my restless spirit.

May Dura grant me forgiveness.

<align="right"><style="stress">Janne Kraff</style>
document:1:573:0.source_cn:
<style="stress">克拉夫特关于葬礼及事务处理的紧急遗嘱</style>
致各位：
本人因在实验中不幸触发<style="highlight">高阶以太分解反应</style>，身体已遭到严重的虚空侵蚀。根据魔法安全条例第7章第3条，为防止虚空扩大波及他人，请在我去世后务必使用<style="highlight">三层特制封印棺椁</style>将我收殓。
切记：严禁任何形式的开棺和净化仪式，否则后果自负！
关于我工位上的私人物品，请务必保持原状，交由我的亲属保管处理。
最后，若念及旧情，请带一瓶金琥珀葡萄酒及巴克千层蛋糕置于我的墓前，好让这些能……安抚我躁动的亡魂。
愿艾雅宽恕。
<align="right"><style="stress">——让内·克拉夫特</style>

Unfortunately, I suffered a <style="highlight">high-tier arcane backlash</style> during an experiment, leaving my body severely corrupted. Pursuant to Article 3, Chapter 7 of the Magical Safety Regulations, my remains must be placed in a <style="highlight">triple-layered sealed coffin</style> to prevent the corruption from spreading to others.

Warning: Do not open the coffin or perform any purification rituals under any circumstances. Ignore this warning at your own peril.

Please ensure the personal belongings on my desk remain in their original state and are handed over to my next of kin.

Lastly, if you wish to pay your respects, please bring a bottle of golden amber wine and a slice of mille-feuille cake to my grave. Hopefully, they can... soothe my restless spirit.

May Dura grant me forgiveness.

<align="right"><style="stress">Janne Kraff</style>

document:0:626:0.text:
我必须承认，M是真理赐予这个世界的最高杰作，那具毫无瑕疵的躯壳里，流淌着如同星辉般纯净的魔力。
每当我看着<male>他</male><female>她</female>站在高塔之上，轻描淡写地修正那些足以让凡人发狂的魔法漏洞时，我的血液里仿佛有千万只毒虫在啃噬。
<male>他</male><female>她</female>那傲慢的慈悲，那种对力量游刃有余的掌控感，无一不在嘲讽着我——嘲讽我这半生为了摸索真理边缘而付出的惨烈代价。
我嫉妒<male>他</male><female>她</female>，嫉妒到发狂。我多想亲手撕碎<male>他</male><female>她</female>的优雅，将<male>他</male><female>她</female>那高洁的灵魂一点点剥扯开来，看那双深邃平静的眼睛里染上绝望与痛苦的底色……

万幸……所有的禁术都有代价，这是不可撼动的铁律。
 在我长期的观测与魔力侧写中，我发现M的灵魂结构极度特殊。<male>他</male><female>她</female>的魔力回路具有一种不可思议的<style="highlight">绝对转化与滤过性</style>。
<male>他</male><female>她</female>像是一个深不见底的渊口，无论投入多么暴戾的黑暗魔法，<male>他</male><female>她</female>都能将其同化、平复，甚至<style="highlight">逆向转化为纯粹的生命本源</style>。
这启发了我：既然<male>他</male><female>她</female>的身体是一个完美的<style="highlight">转化器</style>，为什么不让<male>他</male><female>她</female>成为那个替所有牺牲者承载痛苦的受体呢？

通过改造术式的底层逻辑，我可以建立一条隐秘的<style="highlight">生命力与魔力的置换通道</style>。当施术者试图施展那些逆转生死、违背常理的禁咒时，产生的剧烈反噬与寿命衰减将不再作用于施术者本身。法阵会强制抽取梅林那庞大纯净的魔力与生命力，将其<style="highlight">滤化为结果注入受益者体内</style>。
而施术的代价——那些残疾、衰老、折损寿命以及灵魂被撕裂的剧痛，将顺着法阵，悉数倒灌入梅林的灵魂深处！

我将这一完美的置换仪式称为<style="highlight">救世主的加冕</style>。
<male>他</male><female>她</female>既然那么爱拯救世人，那么我就帮<male>他</male><female>她</female>一把——我要让这位魔法师协会的“首席”，在无尽的黑暗中替所有人流血，成为我通向神明领域的、最完美的垫脚石！

document:0:626:0.male:
I must admit, M is the ultimate masterpiece the Gods have bestowed upon this world. Within that flawless body flows magic as pure as starlight.

Whenever I watch him standing atop the high tower, effortlessly fixing catastrophic magical anomalies that would drive ordinary mortals mad, I find myself unable to look away. My blood burns as if devoured by a thousand stinging insects.

His arrogant charity, his effortless control over absolute power... It all mocks me. It mocks the horrific price I have paid over half my life just to scrape at the mere edges of Truth.

I envy him. I hate him to the point of absolute madness. How I long to shatter his perfect elegance with my own hands. I want to tear his noble soul apart piece by piece, just to see those calm, deep eyes finally drown in despair and agony...

Fortunately, all dark magic demands a price. That law is absolute.

Through my long observations, I discovered that M's soul structure is freakishly unique. His magic circuits possess an incredible <style="highlight">Vortex Assimilation</style> property.

He is like a bottomless abyss. No matter how violent or corrupt the dark magic thrown at him may be, he can absorb and purify it, even <style="highlight">reversing the corruption into pure life force</style>.

This gave me a wonderful idea. Since his body is the perfect <style="highlight">vessel for purification</style>, why not make him the one who bears everyone else's agony?

By rewriting the core logic of the spell, I can forge a secret <style="highlight">Transference Conduit</style>. Whenever a dark mage casts forbidden curses to cheat death or rewrite reality, the violent backlash will no longer hit the caster. Instead, the magic circle will forcibly drain M's vast reserves of pure mana and life force, <style="highlight">purifying it to fuel the caster's spell</style>.

Meanwhile, the true price of forbidden magic: the crippling injuries, accelerated aging, shortened lifespan, and the agonizing pain of a shredded soul... All of it will flow backward through the conduit, directly into the depths of M's soul!

I have named this perfect ritual: <style="highlight">The Savior's Coronation</style>.

Since he loves saving the world so much, then I shall help him fulfill that wish. I'll make the Arcane Council's grand First Seat bleed for eternity in the dark, carrying the burdens of countless others. And when at last those eyes are filled with suffering, he will become the perfect stepping stone on my path toward becoming a God.

document:9:627:0.text:
Report compiled by: Kraff
 
 Annotated by: Cyran
Regarding the border disturbances and illegal smuggling detailed in this report, bury it for now. Do not report this to the upper management.

The royal capital is currently preparing for the <style="highlight">Ascension Festival</style>, a political undertaking of utmost importance intended to showcase the empire's prosperity and reassure the populace. At this time, we cannot let border rumors and minor skirmishes ruin the festive atmosphere.

As for the questionable activities of certain merchant guilds, Internal Affairs will handle matters separately.
Cyran

--------------------------------------------------



[Border Unrest and the Smuggling Network]
Recent surveillance indicates frequent unrest along the border between the Lightbearer Empire and Bantus. The undead within Bantus appear to be experiencing an unusual agitation. Accompanying this phenomenon is the emergence of several "merchant guilds" on the border running an extremely dangerous smuggling enterprise in secret.
Drawing upon primitive shamanic practices passed down through generations, they assist civilians, smugglers, and even fugitives in crossing the border and entering Bantus territory.

[Smuggling Method: The Undead Disguise Ritual]
Any living person seeking entry into the Bantus Empire must first erase every trace of life from themselves. The ritual is crude and deeply unsettling:

Ashen Mask: The smugglers mix the ashes of murder victims with black swamp mud, smearing it over their faces and bodies to completely mask the scent of living flesh.
Deathly Slumber: They chew a toxic border herb known as corpsefern, inducing a coma that mimics death.
Soul Anchoring: The guiding shaman strikes the subject's head using a ritual implement crafted from beast bone, before pressing a splinter of grave-soiled bone beneath their tongue. This acts as a "beacon" for the drifting soul, ensuring their consciousness isn't blown away.

Once the ritual is complete, the subject's heartbeat and body temperature disappear entirely. Even their soul signature becomes indistinguishable from that of a true undead. By assuming this <style="highlight">undead state</style>, they can pass the gaze of Bantus' guards without suspicion.



[Limitations and Fatal Consequences]
Time Restriction: A soul may remain within Bantus for only a limited period. The exact duration varies depending on the ritual used.

Irreversibility: If the soul remains separated from the body for too long, the life essence that binds flesh and spirit together will wither and decay.

Final Outcome: Once that life essence is severed entirely, the subject becomes trapped forever in the <style="highlight">undead state</style>. Their physical body becomes a rotting, empty shell, while their soul is torn apart by the death winds of Bantus and dissolves into nothingness.
document:9:627:0.source_cn:
整理人：克拉夫特
 
 【首席批示】
针对此调研报告中所述的边境异动与非法通关现象，暂缓上报内阁。
目前王都正值筹备<style="highlight">升华庆典</style>的关键时期，此乃彰显帝国繁荣、安抚民心之首要政治任务。大局当前，切勿让这类边境的捕风捉影之词与些许摩擦，破坏了庆典的祥和气氛。
关于某些商会的越界业务，事务司将另行处置。
——迪尔格雷

--------------------------------------------------

【异常观测：边境异动与偷渡产业链】
近期观测表明，耀光与班题斯接壤的边境地带频发异动，班题斯境内的亡灵正处于某种极不寻常的躁动之中。与此异动伴随的，是边境的某些“特殊商会”正在暗中经营一项极其危险的偷渡业务。
他们利用当地一种源自古老萨满的原始巫术，协助当地百姓、走私客甚至逃犯越过边境，踏入班题斯的领土。

【偷渡机制：活死人伪装仪式】
生者若欲踏入亡灵帝国班题斯，必须抹除一切生命的活体特征。该仪式极具原始的野蛮色彩：

骨灰涂面：需将死于非命者的骨灰混合沼泽黑泥，涂抹于偷渡者的七窍与全身，以彻底掩盖生者的血肉气味。
致幻沉眠：令受术者咀嚼一种名为“食尸蕨”的边境毒草，诱导躯壳陷入深度的僵死休眠。
灵肉抽离：引路的萨满使用兽骨制成的法器敲击受术者的天灵盖，并在其舌底压入一枚沾满墓土的碎骨片。此物将作为灵魂出窍后的“引路石”，确保神智不被死亡的阴风卷走。

仪式完成后，活人的心跳与体温会完全消失，灵魂波动与真正的亡灵无异。凭借这种<style="highlight">活死人状态</style>，他们能毫无阻碍地越过守门人的凝视，堂而皇之地潜入班题斯境内。

【术式限制与致命代价】
时效限制：灵魂在班题斯的滞留时间较为短暂，具体时长与所使用仪式相关。
不可逆性：若灵魂长期游离于躯壳之外，维持灵肉联系的“生命本源”会逐渐干枯腐朽。
最终后果：一旦本源断裂，受术者将永远困于<style="highlight">活死人状态</style>，肉身彻底沦为一具腐烂的空壳。而灵魂则会在班题斯的阴风中被彻底撕碎，化为虚无。
