say:10:1711159010:1.source_cn: 我很清楚，他们都不会同意……这是我的决定，是我一厢情愿...
say:10:1711159010:1.male: I am under no illusions, Merlin. My family would never allow this.
say:10:1711159010:1.female: I am under no illusions, Merlin. My family would never allow this.

say:11:1711159011:1.text: But this is my choice, and my selfish determination.
say:11:1711159011:1.source_cn: 我没有征得他们的同意，也不打算在事前商量。
say:11:1711159011:1.male: But this is my choice, and my selfish determination.
say:11:1711159011:1.female: But this is my choice, and my selfish determination.

say:12:1711159012:1.text: Savannah needs a healthy king, not a queen who spends her days over a sickbed.
say:12:1711159012:1.source_cn: 现在的赛凡纳需要一位健康的国王，而不是一位围在病榻前征...
say:12:1711159012:1.male: Savannah needs a healthy king, not a queen who spends her days over a sickbed.
say:12:1711159012:1.female: Savannah needs a healthy king, not a queen who spends her days over a sickbed.

say:13:1711159013:1.text: In this room, there is only you, me, and our resolve to see this through.
say:13:1711159013:1.source_cn: 在这个房间里，只有你，和我，以及这份觉悟。
say:13:1711159013:1.male: In this room, there is only you, me, and our resolve to see this through.
say:13:1711159013:1.female: In this room, there is only you, me, and our resolve to see this through.

say:14:1711159014:1.text: You watch her silently before bringing up the wager the two of you made while studying Cyran's research.
say:14:1711159014:1.source_cn: 你静静地看着她，突然提到了你们研究迪尔格雷论文时的约定。
say:14:1711159014:1.male: You watch her silently before bringing up the wager the two of you made while studying Cyran's research.
say:14:1711159014:1.female: You watch her silently before bringing up the wager the two of you made while studying Cyran's research.

say:15:1711159015:1.text: You won, so she owes you a favor.
say:15:1711159015:1.source_cn: 你胜利了，所以她需要答应你一件事。
say:15:1711159015:1.male: You won, so she owes you a favor.
say:15:1711159015:1.female: You won, so she owes you a favor.

say:16:1711159016:1.text: If it's within my power to grant, then name it.
say:16:1711159016:1.source_cn: 只要是我能给的，请讲，梅林。
say:16:1711159016:1.male: If it's within my power to grant, then name it.
say:16:1711159016:1.female: If it's within my power to grant, then name it.

say:17:1711159017:1.text: Your request is simple. Once the ritual is over, she must tell Maximilian and Peggy exactly what she sacrificed here.
say:17:1711159017:1.source_cn: 你要她做的事情是在仪式结束后，把今天付出的代价，原原本...
say:17:1711159017:1.male: Your request is simple. Once the ritual is over, she must tell Maximilian and Peggy exactly what she sacrificed here.
say:17:1711159017:1.female: Your request is simple. Once the ritual is over, she must tell Maximilian and Peggy exactly what she sacrificed here.

say:18:1711159018:1.text: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
say:18:1711159018:1.source_cn: 为什么？告诉他们真相，除了让他们背负着对我的内疚，还有...
say:18:1711159018:1.male: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
say:18:1711159018:1.female: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.

choice_prompt:19:1711159018.text: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
choice_prompt:19:1711159018.source_cn: 为什么？告诉他们真相，除了让他们背负着对我的内疚，还有什么意义？
choice_prompt:19:1711159018.male: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
choice_prompt:19:1711159018.female: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.

say:20:1711159019:1.text: Even if this is Gwendolyn's burden to bear, and even if the truth weighs heavily on her family...
say:20:1711159019:1.source_cn: 哪怕这是莫德琳一厢情愿的固执，哪怕这不可避免地会给他们...

say:21:1711159020:1.text: When it comes to matters of life and death, being left in the dark by the people you love is its own kind of cruelty. It wouldn't be fair to them.
say:21:1711159020:1.source_cn: 毕竟，在这种关乎生死的事情上，被至亲之人瞒在鼓里的滋味...

say:22:1711159021:1.text: ... I understand. If I'm still conscious afterward, I'll tell them myself.
say:22:1711159021:1.source_cn: ……我懂了。如果我还清醒着，我会亲口告诉他们。
say:22:1711159021:1.male: ... I understand. If I'm still conscious afterward, I'll tell them myself.
say:22:1711159021:1.female: ... I understand. If I'm still conscious afterward, I'll tell them myself.

say:23:1711159022:1.text: Hoping to lighten the mood a bit, you change the topic.
say:23:1711159022:1.source_cn: 为了缓和气氛，你主动提起了另一件事。
say:23:1711159022:1.male: Hoping to lighten the mood a bit, you change the topic.
say:23:1711159022:1.female: Hoping to lighten the mood a bit, you change the topic.

say:24:1711159023:1.text: After the ritual, her magic will be completely burned out. She'll need a successor to take her place in the Arcane Council.
say:24:1711159023:1.source_cn: 这场仪式之后，王后的魔力大概率会彻底枯竭。那么她得提前...

say:25:1711159024:1.text: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.
say:25:1711159024:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我会留意的。可不能让失去魔力的我占据高文席位太久。
say:25:1711159024:1.male: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.
say:25:1711159024:1.female: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.

choice_prompt:26:1711159024.text: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.
choice_prompt:26:1711159024.source_cn: 放心吧，我会留意的。可不能让失去魔力的我占据高文席位太久。
choice_prompt:26:1711159024.male: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.
choice_prompt:26:1711159024.female: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.

say:27:1711159025:1.text: I am in your hands, Magister Merlin.
say:27:1711159025:1.male: I am in your hands, Magister Merlin.
say:27:1711159025:1.female: I am in your hands, Magister Merlin.

narration:28:1711159026:1.text: You guide Queen Gwendolyn and the comatose King Maximilian to the hidden chamber.
narration:28:1711159026:1.male: You guide Queen Gwendolyn and the comatose King Maximilian to the hidden chamber.
narration:28:1711159026:1.female: You guide Queen Gwendolyn and the comatose King Maximilian to the hidden chamber.

narration:29:1711159027:1.text: The Queen gently places her husband at the center of the ritual circle and steps into the opposite side herself.

choice:26:0:1.text: Let's go to Cyran's secret chamber.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们去迪尔格雷的密室吧
choice:26:0:1.male: Let's go to Cyran's secret chamber.
choice:26:0:1.female: Let's go to Cyran's secret chamber.

choice:26:1:2.text: We'll give his ritual a better purpose.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 是时候让那个法阵发挥新的作用了
choice:26:1:2.male: We'll give his ritual a better purpose.
choice:26:1:2.female: We'll give his ritual a better purpose.

choice:19:0:1.text: Because they have a right to know.
choice:19:0:1.male: Because they have a right to know.
choice:19:0:1.female: Because they have a right to know.

choice:19:1:2.text: They need to understand what you gave up.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 他们得知道你付出了什么
choice:19:1:2.male: They need to understand what you gave up.
choice:19:1:2.female: They need to understand what you gave up.

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 佩吉会同意你这么做吗？

choice:8:1:2.text: If Maximilian wakes up, do you think he'd want this?
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 马克西姆醒来后，他会赞同吗？
choice:8:1:2.male: If Maximilian wakes up, do you think he'd want this?
choice:8:1:2.female: If Maximilian wakes up, do you think he'd want this?

say:0:1711162001:1.text: The forces of purification and backlash clash violently within the Queen's body. Ultimately, the overwhelming force of your magic drives the corrupt light back.
say:0:1711162001:1.source_cn: 净化与反噬在王后体内激烈碰撞，最终，在你的强力镇压下，...
say:0:1711162001:1.male: The forces of purification and backlash clash violently within the Queen's body. Ultimately, the overwhelming force of your magic drives the corrupt light back.
say:0:1711162001:1.female: The forces of purification and backlash clash violently within the Queen's body. Ultimately, the overwhelming force of your magic drives the corrupt light back.

say:1:1711162002:1.text: But the purification is incomplete. A few wisps of eerie purple mist still linger around the Queen's eyes.
say:1:1711162002:1.source_cn: 然而，净化并没有彻底完成。几缕诡异的紫色雾气依然萦绕在...

say:2:1711162003:1.text: Until they sink into her eyes...
say:2:1711162003:1.source_cn: 直至悉数钻进了她的眼中……

say:0:1711163001:0.source_cn: 莫德琳，让我看看你的眼睛！

say:0:1711164001:1.text: You see an irreversible magical seal in her eyes. No matter how you attempt to purify it, the rune remains.
say:0:1711164001:1.source_cn: 你的魔力在她的瞳孔深处触碰到了一种绝对不可逆的魔法禁制...
say:0:1711164001:1.male: You see an irreversible magical seal in her eyes. No matter how you attempt to purify it, the rune remains.
say:0:1711164001:1.female: You see an irreversible magical seal in her eyes. No matter how you attempt to purify it, the rune remains.

say:1:1711164002:1.text: Altering reality demands a price, and that price cannot be undone. That is the foundational law of forbidden magic, one that even you can't interfere with.
say:1:1711164002:1.source_cn: 逆转现实需要代价，这份代价无法再度被逆转。这是禁术的底...
say:1:1711164002:1.male: Altering reality demands a price, and that price cannot be undone. That is the foundational law of forbidden magic, one that even you can't interfere with.
say:1:1711164002:1.female: Altering reality demands a price, and that price cannot be undone. That is the foundational law of forbidden magic, one that even you can't interfere with.

say:2:1711164003:1.text: And so, bound by the rules upon which the spell itself was built, the final price Gwendolyn must pay is:
say:2:1711164003:1.source_cn: 所以，基于逆转魔法底层规则的限制，莫德琳承担的最终代价是——

say:3:1711164004:1.text: In time, she will become <style="highlight">completely blind</style>.

say:5:1711164005:1.text: Don't... waste any more of your strength on me.
say:5:1711164005:1.source_cn: 不用……再为我白费力气了。我早就准备好了……接受这一切。
say:5:1711164005:1.male: Don't... waste any more of your strength on me.
say:5:1711164005:1.female: Don't... waste any more of your strength on me.

say:6:1711164006:1.text: I accepted this possibility long ago. At least, I can still see a little for now. I only hope this lasts long enough for me to see Maximilian and Peggy smile one more time.
say:6:1711164006:1.source_cn: 至少，目前我仍残留着模糊的视觉……希望这点余光，能让我...
say:6:1711164006:1.male: I accepted this possibility long ago. At least, I can still see a little for now. I only hope this lasts long enough for me to see Maximilian and Peggy smile one more time.
say:6:1711164006:1.female: I accepted this possibility long ago. At least, I can still see a little for now. I only hope this lasts long enough for me to see Maximilian and Peggy smile one more time.

say:1:1711166001:1.text: I feel like... I've been in a very long dream.
say:1:1711166001:1.source_cn: 我好像……做了一个很漫长的梦。

say:2:1711166002:1.text: I was falling endlessly through an infinite black fog.
say:2:1711166002:1.source_cn: 梦中，我一直在一片无边无际的黑雾里不断坠落。

say:3:1711166003:1.text: I could hear you, Orion, and Peggy calling to me from somewhere beyond the light. I ran toward you with all my might, but no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't reach you.
say:3:1711166003:1.source_cn: 我听见你、奥利安和佩吉在光亮的地方呼唤我，我拼命朝你们...

say:4:1711166004:1.source_cn: 此时此刻，我仍在梦中吗？

say:6:1711166005:1.text: No, this is no dream. Take my hand, feel it.
say:6:1711166005:1.source_cn: 不……马克西姆，这不是梦。握紧我的手，感受它。

say:7:1711166006:1.text: ... Why is your hand so cold?

say:8:1711166007:1.text: You broke your promise... You swore that no matter what happened, you'd take care of yourself. But look at you... you seem more frail than I am.
say:8:1711166007:1.source_cn: 莫德琳……你失言了。你曾答应过我，无论发生什么都会照顾...

say:9:1711166008:1.text: And yet this warmth... this touch... it's real. I brought you back from the fog.
say:9:1711166008:1.source_cn: 但这份温度，这份触感，皆为真实。我把你从黑雾里拉回来了。

say:10:1711166009:1.text: This isn't the place for such a conversation, anyway. Come, let us return to your chambers.
say:10:1711166009:1.source_cn: 这里也不是说话的地方，马克西姆，我们先回你的寝殿吧。

say:11:1711166010:1.text: You've only just awakened. Your body still needs rest.
say:11:1711166010:1.source_cn: 你刚刚苏醒，身体依然需要休息。

say:12:1711166011:1.text: Afterward, I'll tell you everything that has happened, including what I've done.
say:12:1711166011:1.source_cn: 之后，我会把这段时间发生的一切，包括我所做的事，全都毫...

say:2:1711167001:1.text: I can feel it. The deathly presence that clung to my body is gone. In its place is a warmth I've nearly forgotten... like the first light of dawn.
say:2:1711167001:1.source_cn: 我能感觉到……那股盘踞在身体里的阴冷死气消失了。取而代...

say:3:1711167002:1.text: Dura has smiled upon us, Maximilian. You made it through.
say:3:1711167002:1.source_cn: 艾雅眷顾，马克西姆，你终于挺过来了。

say:4:1711167003:1.text: This was more than the blessing of the Divine Light, wasn't it? Merlin... and you, Gwendolyn.
say:4:1711167003:1.source_cn: 这不仅仅是圣光的仁慈吧？梅林，还有你……莫德琳。
say:4:1711167003:1.male: This was more than the blessing of the Divine Light, wasn't it? Merlin... and you, Gwendolyn.
say:4:1711167003:1.female: This was more than the blessing of the Divine Light, wasn't it? Merlin... and you, Gwendolyn.

say:6:1711167005:1.text: The details can wait. Until this life force fully settles within you, you need to keep your breathing steady.
say:6:1711167005:1.source_cn: 这些细节晚些再谈。在这股生命力完美契合你的身体之前，你...

say:7:1711167006:1.text: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.
say:7:1711167006:1.source_cn: 梅林，能劳烦你再确认一下马克西姆的身体状况吗？我只相信...
say:7:1711167006:1.male: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.
say:7:1711167006:1.female: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.

choice_prompt:8:1711167006.text: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.
choice_prompt:8:1711167006.source_cn: 梅林，能劳烦你再确认一下马克西姆的身体状况吗？我只相信你的判断。
choice_prompt:8:1711167006.male: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.
choice_prompt:8:1711167006.female: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.

say:9:1711167007:1.text: Empowered by that immense life force, his heart beats strongly, and his body has been completely healed.
say:9:1711167007:1.source_cn: 在那股强大的生命力滋养下，他的心脏搏动有力，受损的身体...

say:13:1711167010:1.text: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
say:13:1711167010:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道你们付出了怎样的努力，但是，梅林，请接受我最...
say:13:1711167010:1.male: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
say:13:1711167010:1.female: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.

choice_prompt:14:1711167010.text: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.source_cn: 虽然不知道你们付出了怎样的努力，但是，梅林，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.male: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.female: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.

say:15:1711167011:1.text: You have saved both the empire and my life time and time again. You are the closest friend the Lightbearer royal family has ever known.
say:15:1711167011:1.source_cn: 你一次次拯救了帝国，拯救了我，你是耀光王室最亲密的朋友。

say:16:1711167014:1.text: But for now, enjoy this moment of peace. There is a mountain of state affairs waiting for your attention; you won't be resting for long.
say:16:1711167014:1.source_cn: 好了，马克西姆，享受这短暂的轻松吧。还有一堆复杂的政务...

say:17:1711167015:1.text: These past few years have been hard on you.

say:18:1711167016:1.text: But before that... I'd like to see Orion and Peggy.
say:18:1711167016:1.source_cn: 不过，在那之前，我想见见奥利安和佩吉——

say:20:1711167012:1.text: Gwendolyn... I can tell you've done something incredibly dangerous behind my back.
say:20:1711167012:1.source_cn: 莫德琳……我能感觉到，你瞒着我做了一件极其危险的事。

say:21:1711167013:1.text: ... I will tell you and Peggy everything, I promise.
say:21:1711167013:1.source_cn: ……我会把一切都原原本本地告诉你和佩吉的，我保证。

choice:14:1:2.text: The one you should thank most is Gwendolyn.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 你最该感谢的是莫德琳
choice:14:1:2.male: The one you should thank most is Gwendolyn.
choice:14:1:2.female: The one you should thank most is Gwendolyn.

narration:0:1711169001:1.text: You let the family have this rare quiet moment to themselves after everything they've been through.
narration:0:1711169001:1.male: You let the family have this rare quiet moment to themselves after everything they've been through.
narration:0:1711169001:1.female: You let the family have this rare quiet moment to themselves after everything they've been through.

narration:1:1711169002:1.text: Life as a Lightbearer royal family member comes with crushing pressure. The never-ending political conflicts are enough to wear anyone down.

narration:2:1711169003:1.text: What fate awaits in the wake of the Queen's blindness, Orion's departure, the mess Cyran left behind, and the border conflicts with Bantus? All will be revealed in time.

narration:3:1711169004:1.text: For now, let this little world belong to just the three of them, and let them bask in the joy of finding each other again.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711129001:.text: Doesn't seem like he's here either—huh?!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1711129001:.male: Doesn't seem like he's here either—huh?!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1711129001:.female: Doesn't seem like he's here either—huh?!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711168004:.text: I've waited so long for this day...

say:0:1711101001:0.text: I've finished my research; I can go talk to Modlyn now.
say:0:1711101001:0.source_cn: 研究得差不多了，可以去找莫德琳谈谈了。

say:2:1711102002:1.text: But before I hear your victory speech, would you like to hear about my dream from last night?
say:2:1711102002:1.source_cn: 不过，在听你的胜利感言之前，要不要先听听我昨夜的梦？

say:3:1711102003:1.text: That was... a long-lost, wonderful dream.
say:3:1711102003:1.source_cn: 那是一个……久违的奇妙美梦。

choice_prompt:4:1711102003.text: That was... a long-lost, wonderful dream.
choice_prompt:4:1711102003.source_cn: 那是一个……久违的奇妙美梦。

say:5:1711102004:1.text: Yes, I dreamt that I turned into a firefly.
say:5:1711102004:1.source_cn: 是的，我梦到自己变成了一只萤火虫。

choice_prompt:10:1711102009.text: At that moment, it seemed as if other fireflies were calling to me, but before I could see them clearly, I left the dream.
choice_prompt:10:1711102009.source_cn: 那时，似乎有其他的萤火虫在呼唤我，但我还未看清它们的身影，便离开了梦境。

say:12:1711102012:1.text: I can open my eyes calmly, instead of waking up in despair and fear.
say:12:1711102012:1.source_cn: 我能在平静的状态下睁开双眼，而不是在绝望和恐惧中惊厥着醒来。

say:14:1711102014:1.text: Alright, the dream is over. Merlin, tell me about your research on forbidden techniques.
say:14:1711102014:1.source_cn: 好了，梦醒了。梅林，告诉我你对禁术的研究吧。

choice_prompt:15:1711102014.text: Alright, the dream is over. Merlin, tell me about your research on forbidden techniques.
choice_prompt:15:1711102014.source_cn: 好了，梦醒了。梅林，告诉我你对禁术的研究吧。

say:18:1711102017:1.text: Therefore, you must tell her the price without reservation—
say:18:1711102017:1.source_cn: 所以，你必须把代价毫无保留地告诉她——

choice_prompt:19:1711102017.text: Therefore, you must tell her the price without reservation—
choice_prompt:19:1711102017.source_cn: 所以，你必须把代价毫无保留地告诉她——

say:20:1711102018:0.text: Although I feel guilty for failing Maxim's request, I am willing.
say:20:1711102018:0.source_cn: 尽管愧对于马克西姆的嘱托，但我愿意。

choice:19:0:1.text: Queen, would you be willing if you could no longer use magic?
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 王后，如果从此无法使用魔法，你愿意吗？

say:21:1711102019:0.text: Although I feel I have failed my teacher's guidance, I am willing to do so.
say:21:1711102019:0.source_cn: 尽管愧对于老师的教导，但我愿意。

choice:19:1:2.text: Modlyn, would you be willing if you could never have precognitive dreams again?
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 莫德琳，如果再也做不了预知梦，你愿意吗？

say:22:1711102020:0.text: Although I feel guilty for betraying your trust, I am willing.
say:22:1711102020:0.source_cn: 尽管愧对于你的信任，但我愿意。

choice:19:2:3.text: Gawain, would you be willing to lose your status as a magician?
choice:19:2:3.source_cn: 高文，如果失去魔法师的身份，你愿意吗？

say:24:1711102022:1.text: This means she will permanently lose the ability to cast spells, but will be able to save her life.
say:24:1711102022:1.source_cn: 这意味着，她将永久失去施法的能力，但能保住性命。

say:25:1711102023:1.text: I see… burning talent instead of lifespan. That’s a wonderfully gentle suggestion.
say:25:1711102023:1.source_cn: 原来如此……燃烧天赋而非寿命。这真是一个绝妙的温柔提议。

choice_prompt:26:1711102023.text: I see… burning talent instead of lifespan. That’s a wonderfully gentle suggestion.
choice_prompt:26:1711102023.source_cn: 原来如此……燃烧天赋而非寿命。这真是一个绝妙的温柔提议。

say:29:1711102026:1.text: For me now, how much use is magic?
say:29:1711102026:1.source_cn: 对于现在的我而言，魔法，还有多大的作用呢？

choice_prompt:31:1711102027.text: If it can be used to awaken Maxim, I think that would be its final and greatest achievement.
choice_prompt:31:1711102027.source_cn: 倘若能用它换来马克西姆的苏醒，我想，这便是它最后也是最大的功劳了。

say:32:1711102028:1.text: Having lost my magic, I am no longer a magician, and naturally, I can no longer bear the name of Gawain.
say:32:1711102028:1.source_cn: 失去了魔法，我便不再是一名魔法师，自然不能再坐拥高文之名。

say:34:1711102030:1.text: However, I believe you can find a more suitable successor.
say:34:1711102030:1.source_cn: 不过，我相信，你能找到更合适的继任者。

choice_prompt:35:1711102030.text: However, I believe you can find a more suitable successor.
choice_prompt:35:1711102030.source_cn: 不过，我相信，你能找到更合适的继任者。

say:36:1711102031:1.text: That's because you tolerated my willfulness. Thank you, Merlin.
say:36:1711102031:1.source_cn: 那也是你容忍了我的任性。感谢你，梅林。

choice_prompt:38:1711102032.text: I will always be your partner, and I will always remember every moment we've shared. As long as I live, Radiance will always be your ally.
choice_prompt:38:1711102032.source_cn: 我永远是你的伙伴，永远铭记与你经历过的点点滴滴，只要我生存于世，耀光永远是你的盟友。

say:39:1711102033:1.text: Actually, the reason I was so eager to wake Maxim up was also for Peggy's sake.
say:39:1711102033:1.source_cn: 其实，我这么急着救醒马克西姆，也是为了佩吉。

say:40:1711102034:1.text: Peggy is still young, but she already understands that the scepter and crown are not only an honor, but also a responsibility.
say:40:1711102034:1.source_cn: 佩吉年纪尚小，但她已经理解，权杖和王冠不仅是荣耀，更是责任。

say:43:1711102037:1.text: This is also a bit of my selfishness as a mother.
say:43:1711102037:1.source_cn: 这也是我身为母亲的一点私心。

choice_prompt:45:1711102038.text: Moreover, given the current situation, even if Peggy wanted to ascend the throne, she couldn't hold a proper coronation ceremony. Because the Emperor had taken the sword from the stone again…
choice_prompt:45:1711102038.source_cn: 何况，现在的局势，就算佩吉想继位，也无法举行正统的加冕仪式。因为大帝又拿走了石中剑……

say:46:1711102039:1.text: That's right. Without the sword in the stone as a witness, the new king's legitimacy would be questioned by the nobles.
say:46:1711102039:1.source_cn: 没错。没有石中剑的见证，新王的合法性会受到贵族们的质疑。

choice_prompt:48:1711102041.text: He took the real Sword in the Stone, and the sword in the Holy Antiquities was replaced by the fake sword we had previously replaced.
choice_prompt:48:1711102041.source_cn: 他带走了真正的石中剑，圣古堂里的剑又变成了我们之前替换过的伪剑。

say:49:1711102042:1.text: Very well, the Emperor has no ill intentions towards Yaoguang, perhaps he has had new considerations of his own.
say:49:1711102042:1.source_cn: 也好，大帝对耀光绝无恶意，或许是他自己又有了新的考量。

say:50:1711102043:1.text: So, I'll take this opportunity to make final preparations to ensure the operation goes perfectly.
say:50:1711102043:1.source_cn: 那么趁此时间，我也去做最后的准备，确保操作万无一失。

say:51:1711102044:1.text: Once everything is ready, we will proceed with the ceremony.
say:51:1711102044:1.source_cn: 等一切准备就绪，我们就进行仪式。

choice:48:0:1.source_cn: 是又发生了什么事情吗？

choice:48:1:2.text: Looks like I'll have to go ask him.

choice:45:0:1.text: Roland took the sword in the stone?

choice:38:0:1.text: Have you thought about how to explain this to Peggy?
choice:38:0:1.source_cn: 你有想过怎么跟佩吉交代吗？

choice:35:0:1.text: It seems you've made up your mind.

choice:31:0:1.text: But what about Gao Wen's seat?
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 可是，高文的席位怎么办？

choice:26:0:1.text: There's no going back. Have you thought it through?
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 没有后悔的余地，你想好了吗？

choice:19:3:4.text: —Then, pay the price with your magic.

say:54:1711102011:1.text: Really? But I don't feel sad.
say:54:1711102011:1.source_cn: 是吗？但我并不觉得悲伤。

say:55:1711102005:1.text: Perhaps it contains some revelation, but I think it's just an ordinary dream.
say:55:1711102005:1.source_cn: 也许它隐藏着某些启示，但我认为，那只是一个普通的美梦。

say:0:1711103001:0.text: Let's go check the fox den first.
say:0:1711103001:0.source_cn: 先去狐狸窝那里找找看吧。

say:0:1711103101:0.text: The little fox isn't here right now. Let's wait and see, and then we'll go find him.
say:0:1711103101:0.source_cn: 小狐狸暂时不在这里，先等等看，不行再去找他。

say:0:1711104001:0.text: It hasn't come back... Go ask if anyone has seen it.
say:0:1711104001:0.source_cn: 一直没回来……去问问有没有人见过它。

say:1:1711105001:1.text: Ah... are you also a follower of Emperor Roland?
say:1:1711105001:1.source_cn: 啊……你也是罗兰大帝的追随者吗？

choice_prompt:2:1711105001.text: Ah... are you also a follower of Emperor Roland?
choice_prompt:2:1711105001.source_cn: 啊……你也是罗兰大帝的追随者吗？

say:3:1711105002:0.text: So what's your purpose? I'll have to keep a close eye on you!
say:3:1711105002:0.source_cn: 那你的目的是什么？我可要仔细看着点你！

say:6:1711105007:1.text: But people don't understand this principle and keep bothering him!
say:6:1711105007:1.source_cn: 可是大家不懂这个道理，总是来烦他！

say:7:1711105008:1.text: Although I really want to see him in person, I've heard he's a very handsome man...
say:7:1711105008:1.source_cn: 虽然我也很想一睹真容，听说是个非常俊美的男子……

say:10:1711105003:1.text: Me too, but I only started following recently, so my loyalty isn't high enough!
say:10:1711105003:1.source_cn: 我也是，不过我是最近才开始追随的，忠诚度不够高！

say:11:1711105004:1.text: We should address him as Emperor Roland, although the nickname "little fox" is surprisingly cute...
say:11:1711105004:1.source_cn: 要尊称罗兰大帝，虽然小狐狸的称呼意外地有点可爱……

choice:2:2:3.text: Where did the little fox go?

choice_prompt:2:1711106001.text: How exactly do I pass the review and join the Guardian Association? I'm a genuine, fervent follower!
choice_prompt:2:1711106001.source_cn: 到底要怎样才能通过审核加入守护会啊？我可是货真价实的狂热追随者啊！

say:7:1711106006:1.text: I wouldn't know then, since I'm not in the Guardian Council...
say:7:1711106006:1.source_cn: 那我就不知道了，毕竟我不在守护会中……

say:8:1711106007:1.text: Roland, now appearing in fox form, is indeed more elusive than usual.
say:8:1711106007:1.source_cn: 现在的罗兰以狐狸形态示人，确实比平日里更神出鬼没。

choice_prompt:10:1711106008.text: Although this organization, which calls itself the "Guardians" but is actually a "stalker," is extremely suspicious, it seems to be the only shortcut if they want to pinpoint the fox's location in the Severnari.
choice_prompt:10:1711106008.source_cn: 虽然这种名为“守护会”实为“跟踪狂”的组织极度可疑，但如果想要赛凡纳里精准定位那只狐狸，这似乎是唯一的捷径。

choice:10:0:1.text: (Asking the youth about the location of the Guardian Association)

choice:2:0:1.text: The Guardian Association, could it be...?

say:0:1711107001:0.text: Try going to the Guardian Association!
say:0:1711107001:0.source_cn: 去守护会那里试试看吧！

say:1:1711108002:0.text: Roland the Great! Roland the Great!

say:1:1711109001:1.text: Hmph... These days, everyone claims to be a follower of Emperor Roland!
say:1:1711109001:1.source_cn: 哼……这年头，谁都说自己是罗兰大帝的追随者！

say:2:1711109002:0.text: But whether they are true followers or not, we can make our own judgment!
say:2:1711109002:0.source_cn: 但究竟是不是真正的追随者，我们自有判断！

choice_prompt:8:1711109006.text: Show us the support that will satisfy us, make the Emperor pause, and turn the city's attention! Prove the depth of your fervor!
choice_prompt:8:1711109006.source_cn: 展现出令我们满意、令大帝驻足、令全城侧目的应援吧！证明你狂热的深度！

say:10:1711109008:1.text: Listen up! If you're not one of those pseudo-believers who only talk the talk, then prove it with your actions!
say:10:1711109008:1.source_cn: 听好了！如果你不是那些只会动嘴皮子的伪信徒，就用行动来证明！

choice_prompt:12:1711109009.text: Right here! In this sacred area! Wave your glow sticks toward the statue of Roland the Great!
choice_prompt:12:1711109009.source_cn: 就在这里！在这个神圣的区域！向着罗兰大帝的雕像，挥舞荧光棒吧！

say:13:1711109010:1.text: What? Hesitating? True love doesn't hesitate!
say:13:1711109010:1.source_cn: 怎么？犹豫了？真正的爱是不会犹豫的！

choice:12:0:1.text: ...Do you really want to wave it?

say:15:1711109011:1.text: Oh! Your eyes have changed! These are the eyes of enlightenment! Quick, let us see your sincerity!
say:15:1711109011:1.source_cn: 哦！你的眼神变了！这是觉悟的眼神！快，让我们看看你的诚意！

choice:12:1:2.text: For a clue... I'll risk it all!

say:0:1711110001:0.text: Looks like we have to get started! Let's begin!
say:0:1711110001:0.source_cn: 看来必须挥舞了！开始吧！

choice_prompt:6:1711111004.text: As family, we hold nothing back! What do you want to ask? We'll tell you everything we know about the Emperor!
choice_prompt:6:1711111004.source_cn: 作为家人，我们绝不藏私！你想问什么？只要是关于大帝的情报，我们知无不言！

choice_prompt:9:1711111006.text: According to reports from the Guardian Council's spies throughout the city, there have been sightings of what appears to be the Emperor... cough, that noble fox, in three different locations recently.
choice_prompt:9:1711111006.source_cn: 据守护会潜伏在全城的眼线汇报，近期有三个地方出现了疑似大帝……咳，那只高贵狐狸的踪迹。

say:12:1711111009:1.text: Finally, there's the riverbank in the upper district, where people often see him lost in thought.
say:12:1711111009:1.source_cn: 最后是上城区的河道边，经常有人看到他在那里发呆。

say:14:1711111011:1.text: In short, Emperor Roland is elusive; whether you can meet him depends entirely on your luck.
say:14:1711111011:1.source_cn: 总之，罗兰大帝行踪如风，能不能见到他，全凭你的运气了。

choice:6:0:1.text: I want to see Emperor Roland.

say:1:1711127002:1.text: It seems I'll have to figure it out myself... Maybe I can try my luck somewhere else?
say:1:1711127002:1.source_cn: 看来只能自己想办法了……或许，能去别的地方碰碰运气？

say:2:1711127003:1.text: For example, a place known only to the two of you—the Fortified Council Chamber.
say:2:1711127003:1.source_cn: 比如，一个只有你们两个人才知道的地方——坚壁议事厅。

choice_prompt:5:1711130003.text: Mmm! This tastes really good. I never imagined I'd actually improve the overall living standards of the fox clan in the capital. That's wonderful!
choice_prompt:5:1711130003.source_cn: 唔！味道真不错。真没想到，我居然还拉动了王都狐狸一族的整体生活水平。真是好事啊！

say:6:1711130004:1.text: I've been working tirelessly for Savannah all along; you just don't understand how hard I've worked.
say:6:1711130004:1.source_cn: 我可是一直在为赛凡纳操劳，是你不理解我的辛苦。

say:8:1711130008:1.text: But what brings you here to see me, fox? It can't be just to offer me some food, can it?
say:8:1711130008:1.source_cn: 不过，你来找本狐是有什么事吗？总不能是为了献上点美食吧？

choice_prompt:9:1711130008.text: But what brings you here to see me, fox? It can't be just to offer me some food, can it?
choice_prompt:9:1711130008.source_cn: 不过，你来找本狐是有什么事吗？总不能是为了献上点美食吧？

say:10:1711130009:1.text: Oh? It seems you've gone to see the Queen.
say:10:1711130009:1.source_cn: 哦？看来你去见过王后了。

say:12:1711130011:1.text: Let me think about where I should begin—
say:12:1711130011:1.source_cn: 让我想想，究竟该从何说起比较好——

say:14:1711130012:1.text: I heard the bells... It's time.
say:14:1711130012:1.source_cn: 我听见了钟声……是时候了。

say:15:1711130013:1.text: Roland, on this long journey to our destined day, we finally stand side by side here.
say:15:1711130013:1.source_cn: 罗兰，在这条通往命定之日的漫长征途中，我们终于并肩立于此地。

say:18:1711130016:1.text: He is a mortal with warm flesh and blood, who bleeds and gets tired.
say:18:1711130016:1.source_cn: 而是一个有着温热血肉、会流血、也会感到疲惫的凡人。

say:21:1711130019:1.text: Very good, Roland. This is precisely the most dazzling glimmer of humanity.
say:21:1711130019:1.source_cn: 很好，罗兰。这正是人类最耀眼的微光。

say:27:1711130024:1.text: I, Roland Augusta, hereby swear to the goddess of life—
say:27:1711130024:1.source_cn: 我，罗兰·奥古斯塔，在此向生命女神起誓——

say:29:1711130026:1.text: As long as this sword remains unbroken, the flame of Esperia's life will never be extinguished!
say:29:1711130026:1.source_cn: 只要此剑不断，伊索米亚的生命之火，便永不熄灭！

say:30:1711130027:0.text: So go and fight, defeat those shadows of the abyss!
say:30:1711130027:0.source_cn: 那么，去战斗吧，击败那些深渊之影！

choice:9:1:2.text: Why did you go to see Mordrine?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 你为什么去找了莫德琳？

choice:5:0:1.text: Can you be serious for once...?

say:32:1711130006:1.text: Even if I can survive without food, I still respect appetite.
say:32:1711130006:1.source_cn: 就算不需要食物也能维持存在，但我仍然尊重食欲。

say:33:1711130007:1.text: Food is a microcosm of human civilization; eating reminds me of my original identity.
say:33:1711130007:1.source_cn: 美食可是人类文明的缩影，吃东西会让我铭记自己原本的身份。

choice:5:1:2.text: You still have the appetite to eat!

say:4:1711131003:0.text: That malice, intent on devouring everything, still lingers at the bottom of the untouchable abyss.
say:4:1711131003:0.source_cn: 那意图吞噬万物的恶意，依然盘踞在不可触及的深渊之底。

say:6:1711131005:1.text: It seems that this arduous and protracted struggle is far from over.
say:6:1711131005:1.source_cn: 看来这艰苦卓绝的抗争，还远远没有到谢幕的时候。

say:13:1711131012:1.text: You, with your mortal body, created a miracle that even the gods marvel at. Regarding this—
say:13:1711131012:1.source_cn: 你以凡人的血肉之躯，创造了连神明也为之侧目的奇迹。对此——

say:16:1711131015:1.text: If you are willing to grant me the privilege of continuing to accompany it, I will accept this eternal responsibility.
say:16:1711131015:1.source_cn: 如果您愿意赋予我继续陪伴它的特权，我将接下这份永恒的责任。

say:18:1711131017:1.text: I refuse to exercise this right, Goddess.
say:18:1711131017:1.source_cn: 我拒绝行使这项权利，女神。

say:21:1711131020:1.text: Therefore, I return this choice to you, to the immortal gods.
say:21:1711131020:1.source_cn: 所以，我将这个选择权交还给您，交还给不朽的神明。

say:23:1711131022:1.text: Roland, plunge your sword into this rock.
say:23:1711131022:1.source_cn: 罗兰，将你的剑，刺入这块磐石之中。

say:27:1711131025:1.text: When a baby is separated from its mother, the umbilical cord must be severed in order to gain independent life.
say:27:1711131025:1.source_cn: 婴儿脱离母体之时，必须斩断相连的脐带，方能获得独立的生命。

say:28:1711131026:1.text: And the gods were originally closely connected with the beings who created them.
say:28:1711131026:1.source_cn: 而神明，原本也与创造祂们的存在紧紧相连。

say:31:1711131029:1.text: What is the Tree of Life?

say:33:1711131031:1.text: When I decided to walk the path I had chosen, I severed it with my own hands, regardless of the cost.
say:33:1711131031:1.source_cn: 当我决心走上自己选择的道路时，我不顾一切代价，亲手斩断了它。

say:35:1711131033:1.text: The one who draws the sword is qualified to inherit the Radiant Empire.
say:35:1711131033:1.source_cn: 拔剑者，即拥有继承耀光帝国的资格。

say:0:1711132001:0.text: Keep this stone. It should be of some help to you.
say:0:1711132001:0.source_cn: 这石头，你收着吧。它对你应该有所帮助。

say:1:1711132002:0.text: You just handed it over to me like that?

say:2:1711133002:0.text: After all, the sword in the stone can no longer be used to select an heir.
say:2:1711133002:0.source_cn: 毕竟，石中剑也不能再用来选拔继承人了。

choice_prompt:3:1711133002.text: After all, the sword in the stone can no longer be used to select an heir.
choice_prompt:3:1711133002.source_cn: 毕竟，石中剑也不能再用来选拔继承人了。

say:5:1711133004:0.text: The goddess Aya has disappeared without warning.
say:5:1711133004:0.source_cn: 女神艾雅，毫无预兆地下落不明了。

choice_prompt:9:1711133007.text: Fortunately, you were there, leading the Mage Guild to help Esperia through that devastating disaster.
choice_prompt:9:1711133007.source_cn: 幸亏当时有你，带领着魔法师协会帮助伊索米亚度过了那场毁灭性的灾难。

say:11:1711133009:0.text: And you seem to have investigated this matter, but later, you fell into a long slumber...
say:11:1711133009:0.source_cn: 而你似乎也调查过此事，但是后来，你陷入了漫长的沉睡……

say:12:1711133010:0.text: Perhaps, like you, Aya is sleeping somewhere for some reason.
say:12:1711133010:0.source_cn: 也许，艾雅也和你一样，正在某处因为什么原因而沉睡着。

say:13:1711133011:0.text: This time, you came to Severna. That's why I'm showing myself in public again.
say:13:1711133011:0.source_cn: 这次，你来到了赛凡纳。我也是因此才再次现身于人前。

choice_prompt:14:1711133011.text: This time, you came to Severna. That's why I'm showing myself in public again.
choice_prompt:14:1711133011.source_cn: 这次，你来到了赛凡纳。我也是因此才再次现身于人前。

say:16:1711133013:0.text: In short, you have awakened from your slumber, and everything will eventually come to a conclusion.
say:16:1711133013:0.source_cn: 总之，你已经从沉睡中醒来了，一切总会有结果的。

choice_prompt:17:1711133013.text: In short, you have awakened from your slumber, and everything will eventually come to a conclusion.
choice_prompt:17:1711133013.source_cn: 总之，你已经从沉睡中醒来了，一切总会有结果的。

say:19:1711133015:0.text: I respect human choices, even if they are wrong.
say:19:1711133015:0.source_cn: 我尊重人类的选择，哪怕那是错的。

say:23:1711133019:0.text: You remembered something the little fox had entrusted to you for safekeeping—the scabbard of the sword in the stone.
say:23:1711133019:0.source_cn: 你想起了之前小狐狸交给你保管的一样东西——石中剑的剑鞘。

choice_prompt:24:1711133019.text: You remembered something the little fox had entrusted to you for safekeeping—the scabbard of the sword in the stone.
choice_prompt:24:1711133019.source_cn: 你想起了之前小狐狸交给你保管的一样东西——石中剑的剑鞘。

say:25:1711133020:1.text: I'd completely forgotten about it; you have such a good memory!
say:25:1711133020:1.source_cn: 我都把它给忘了，还是你记性好！

say:28:1711133022:0.text: Go ahead and clean up that mess outside. The rest is up to you.
say:28:1711133022:0.source_cn: 去吧，去解决外面的那些烂摊子。接下来，就交给你们啦。

choice:24:1:2.text: The scabbard should be returned to its rightful owner.

choice:24:2:3.text: Your sword is still missing a scabbard.
choice:24:2:3.source_cn: 你的剑还缺了一把剑鞘

choice:14:0:1.text: (Trying hard to recall, but my mind is blank)

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 那么，艾雅究竟去哪里了？

say:1:1711135001:1.text: You're back. Judging from your expression, it seems you've already gotten the answer from the Emperor?
say:1:1711135001:1.source_cn: 你回来了。看你的神情，似乎已经在大帝那里得到了答案？

say:6:1711135006:1.text: So that's how it is... Without the watchful eye of the gods, royal power can only be returned to mortals in the end.
say:6:1711135006:1.source_cn: 原来如此……失去了神明的注视，王权终究只能交还给凡人。

say:8:1711135008:1.source_cn: 那个仪式……我已经做好准备了。

choice_prompt:9:1711135008.source_cn: 那个仪式……我已经做好准备了。

say:10:1711135009:1.text: I was prepared to pay the price long ago.
say:10:1711135009:1.source_cn: 我早就有了付出代价的觉悟。

say:14:1711135013:1.text: Over the years, I have pondered it countless times in my dreams, but I have never been able to fully understand it.
say:14:1711135013:1.source_cn: 这些年，我曾无数次在梦中反复咀嚼它，却始终无法完全想通。

choice_prompt:15:1711135013.text: Over the years, I have pondered it countless times in my dreams, but I have never been able to fully understand it.
choice_prompt:15:1711135013.source_cn: 这些年，我曾无数次在梦中反复咀嚼它，却始终无法完全想通。

say:16:1711135014:1.text: The original message was very brief; it was a code.
say:16:1711135014:1.source_cn: 原话非常简短，是一个暗号。

say:17:1711135017:1.text: Only shadows can see the light. The deepest secrets are forever hidden in the folds of secrets.
say:17:1711135017:1.source_cn: 唯有影子能看见光。最深的秘密，永远藏匿于秘密的皱褶中。

choice_prompt:20:1711135019.text: One day in the future, by giving the other party a secret code, you can retrieve an important item that could turn the tide of the war.
choice_prompt:20:1711135019.source_cn: 在未来的某一天，向对方报上暗号，就能取回一件足以扭转时局的重要物品。

choice_prompt:24:1711135024.text: Shadows can see the light, and there are many shadows hiding in Savannah, but which shadow is worthy of your trust?
choice_prompt:24:1711135024.source_cn: 影子能看见光，藏身于赛凡纳的暗影可不少，但是哪一道影子值得被曾经的你信任呢？

choice_prompt:27:1711135026.text: If it's him, he certainly has the ability to keep those important secrets for you, but why him? Did you really trust him so much back then?
choice_prompt:27:1711135026.source_cn: 如果是他，确实有能力替你保管那些重要的秘密，可为什么是他呢？曾经的你竟然如此信任过他吗？

say:28:1711135027:1.text: Go forth, and if the truth lies hidden in the shadows, may you bring it back into the light.
say:28:1711135027:1.source_cn: 去吧，如果真相藏于阴影里，愿你将它带回光明之中。

choice:27:0:1.text: It seems I'll have to go see this "old acquaintance" again.
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 看来我得再去见见这位“老熟人”了

choice:27:1:2.text: I hope he doesn't lose my things.
choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 希望他别把我的东西弄丢了

choice:24:1:2.text: Hidden in the shadows, yet holding a secret?
choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 藏身于暗影之中，又掌握秘密？

say:30:1711135021:1.text: You didn't tell me the other person's name, or even what they looked like or their identity.
say:30:1711135021:1.source_cn: 你并没有告诉我对方的名字，甚至连长相、身份都没提。

say:31:1711135022:1.text: You didn't mention it at all either; this was the clue you entrusted to me before you lost your memory.
say:31:1711135022:1.source_cn: 你同样只字未提，这是你失忆前托付给我的线索。

say:32:1711135015:1.text: Your expression back then was much more serious than it is now; there was no hint of joking in it.
say:32:1711135015:1.source_cn: 你那时候的神情可比现在严肃得多，一点玩笑的意思都没有。

choice:15:1:2.text: How did I become a riddle solver?

say:33:1711135016:1.text: Perhaps something even more valuable than gold coins and treasure...
say:33:1711135016:1.source_cn: 也许是比金币和财宝更加贵重的东西……

choice:15:2:3.text: Did I leave myself a large sum of money?
choice:15:2:3.source_cn: 难道我给自己留了一大笔钱？

choice:9:0:1.text: Have you really thought this through?

say:0:1711136001:0.text: Let's try going to Edgar, but... do we even know each other that well...?
say:0:1711136001:0.source_cn: 去找埃德加试试吧，只不过，我跟他竟然这么熟悉过吗……

say:4:1711137004:1.text: The Black Gold Guild's forbidden spell... and the heavy price to pay?
say:4:1711137004:1.source_cn: 黑金商会的禁咒……还有惨重的代价？

say:6:1711137006:1.text: Well then, as per the rules, one piece of information leads to one question. What would you like to know this time?
say:6:1711137006:1.source_cn: 那么，按照规矩，一个情报换一个问题。阁下这次想知道什么呢？

choice_prompt:9:1711137008.text: Oh? That's quite an unexpected question. Could it be that the great Lord Merlin has finally recovered from his mental lapse and remembered his past?
choice_prompt:9:1711137008.source_cn: 哦？真是令人意外的问题。难道说，伟大的梅林阁下终于治好了脑子，想起了曾经的过往？

say:10:1711137009:1.text: That's such a shame. I thought it would save me a lot of trouble in rebuilding trust.
say:10:1711137009:1.source_cn: 那真是太遗憾了，在下还以为能省去许多重新建立信任的麻烦呢。

say:11:1711137011:1.text: Since your memory is incomplete, please forgive me for not being able to provide any further information.
say:11:1711137011:1.source_cn: 既然阁下的记忆并不完整，那请恕在下无可奉告。

choice_prompt:12:1711137011.text: Since your memory is incomplete, please forgive me for not being able to provide any further information.
choice_prompt:12:1711137011.source_cn: 既然阁下的记忆并不完整，那请恕在下无可奉告。

say:14:1711137013:1.text: Since it's intelligence, it can't be given away for free.
say:14:1711137013:1.source_cn: 既然是情报，自然不能免费赠送。

choice_prompt:16:1711137014.text: ...This guy is a real swindler; he even charges for catching up. It seems we can't get anything out of his past relationship; I'd better just ask directly.
choice_prompt:16:1711137014.source_cn: ……这个家伙真是一个奸商，连叙旧都要收钱。过往关系看来试探不出什么，还是直接发问吧。

say:19:1711137016:1.source_cn: 这句话……真是令在下感到意外……

say:20:1711137017:1.text: To be honest, I thought you had completely forgotten about it and would never mention it again.
say:20:1711137017:1.source_cn: 老实说，我还以为您已经彻底忘记，永远不会提起此事了。

choice_prompt:24:1711137020.text: In contrast, your current expression, which carries a hint of helplessness, makes you seem more humane.
choice_prompt:24:1711137020.source_cn: 相比之下，现在这种带着点无可奈何的表情，倒是让阁下显得更有人情味了一些。

say:25:1711137021:1.text: You are overthinking it. I have kept your items safe and sound, and they are in perfect condition.
say:25:1711137021:1.source_cn: 阁下多虑了。您要的东西，在下一直好好地收着，毫发无损。

choice:24:0:1.text: Stop trying to get close to me. Is the item still there?
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 少套近乎，东西还在不在？

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 并没有，我还是一头雾水

say:27:1711137010:1.text: Oh? Just a fragment? What a pity.
say:27:1711137010:1.source_cn: 哦？仅仅是片段吗？真是可惜。

say:1:1711138001:1.text: The item has finally been returned to its rightful owner, and I have done my duty.
say:1:1711138001:1.source_cn: 终于物归原主了，在下也算是不负所托。

choice_prompt:4:1711138003.text: But who could blame me when this matter was negotiated by a powerful figure whom I could not refuse under any circumstances?
choice_prompt:4:1711138003.source_cn: 可谁让这件事……是被一位在下无论如何也无法拒绝的大人物说和的呢？

say:5:1711138004:1.text: You don't even remember this, yet you can still accurately recite the code...
say:5:1711138004:1.source_cn: 您连这个都不记得，竟然还能准确无误地说出暗号……

say:6:1711138005:1.text: I suddenly regret it; I shouldn't have returned it to you directly.
say:6:1711138005:1.source_cn: 在下突然有些后悔了，不应该直接还给您才是。

choice_prompt:7:1711138005.text: I suddenly regret it; I shouldn't have returned it to you directly.
choice_prompt:7:1711138005.source_cn: 在下突然有些后悔了，不应该直接还给您才是。

say:8:1711138006:1.text: The client's personal privacy is a top secret, and as for that person's identity... I must keep it a secret even more.
say:8:1711138006:1.source_cn: 客户的个人隐私是顶级机密，至于那位的身份……在下更是要保密。

choice_prompt:10:1711138007.text: I'm sorry, Lord Merlin, even if you bring me the most exclusive information this time, I cannot reveal a single bit to you.
choice_prompt:10:1711138007.source_cn: 抱歉了，梅林阁下，这次就算你拿来再独家的情报，我也无法向你透露分毫。

say:11:1711138008:1.text: How could that be? I have basic professional ethics.
say:11:1711138008:1.source_cn: 怎么会呢？在下有基本的职业操守。

say:13:1711138010:1.text: At most, I just happen to know a little bit of harmless inside information.
say:13:1711138010:1.source_cn: 在下顶多只是……恰好知道一点点无伤大雅的内幕而已。

say:14:1711138011:1.text: As for what earth-shattering secret is hidden within this Star of Memory, please unseal it for yourself.
say:14:1711138011:1.source_cn: 至于这颗记忆之星里究竟藏着什么惊天秘密，就请阁下自行解封吧。

choice:10:0:1.text: Did you already know what was inside?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 你是不是早就知道里面是什么了？

choice:7:0:1.text: Don't change the subject, who is this important person?
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 别转移话题，大人物是谁？

say:1:1711140001:1.text: It seems that the code did indeed point to the person we suspected.
say:1:1711140001:1.source_cn: 看来，那个暗号确实指向了我们猜测的那个人。

choice_prompt:2:1711140001.text: It seems that the code did indeed point to the person we suspected.
choice_prompt:2:1711140001.source_cn: 看来，那个暗号确实指向了我们猜测的那个人。

say:4:1711140004:1.text: You tell Mordrine that it is actually a memory star, containing a piece of your memory.
say:4:1711140004:1.source_cn: 你告知莫德琳，那其实是一颗记忆之星，里面封存着你的某段记忆。

choice:2:0:1.text: Yes, it was Edgar the Hermit.

say:10:1711140003:1.text: That's good. But what is that item?
say:10:1711140003:1.source_cn: 那就好，不过，那是什么物品？

say:2:1711141001:1.text: As you wished, the investigation you commissioned has been completed as quickly as possible.
say:2:1711141001:1.source_cn: 如你所愿，你所委托之调查已以最快速度完成。

choice_prompt:4:1711141002.text: Don't be so stern, Merlin. Isn't this swift and efficient work moving enough to bring tears to the eyes of the dead?
choice_prompt:4:1711141002.source_cn: 别板着脸嘛，梅林。这样雷厉风行的效率难道不叫人感动，令亡灵涕零吗？

say:5:1711141003:1.text: It's just another piece of useless verbal praise. When will Merlin ever become a little more human?
say:5:1711141003:1.source_cn: 又是最无用的口头表扬。什么时候梅林能变得有人情味一点呢？

say:10:1711141008:1.text: Hurry and come here. This matter is of utmost importance, and you are probably the only one in the world capable of resolving it.
say:10:1711141008:1.source_cn: 快些动身来此吧。此事事关重大，恐怕你是世间唯一能解决之人。

choice_prompt:11:1711141008.text: Hurry and come here. This matter is of utmost importance, and you are probably the only one in the world capable of resolving it.
choice_prompt:11:1711141008.source_cn: 快些动身来此吧。此事事关重大，恐怕你是世间唯一能解决之人。

say:12:1711141009:1.text: As soon as possible. Before Bantis discovers it.
say:12:1711141009:1.source_cn: 尽快。在班题斯发现以前。

choice:11:1:2.text: I have other problems to deal with.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 我这边还有别的麻烦要处理

choice:11:2:3.text: Try to cover it up first.

say:0:1711142001:0.text: The person on the other side is...

say:1:1711143001:1.text: You look very serious. Are you alright?
say:1:1711143001:1.source_cn: 你的表情很凝重，还好吗？

say:5:1711143005:1.text: If I remember correctly, a member of the Mage Guild likes to use crows as familiars.
say:5:1711143005:1.source_cn: 如果我没记错，魔法师协会的某一席，喜欢用乌鸦当做使魔。

say:7:1711143007:1.text: You suddenly remember that you obtained a Star of Memory in the Merlin Tower of Lehiram.
say:7:1711143007:1.source_cn: 你忽然想起，在莱希拉姆的梅林塔内，得到过一颗记忆之星。

say:11:1711143010:1.text: If you want to learn more about the Bantis Empire, you can talk to Kosty.
say:11:1711143010:1.source_cn: 如果你想深入了解班题斯帝国的相关信息，可以去找科丝蒂聊聊。

choice_prompt:14:1711143012.text: Speaking of which... the court magician who was mainly in charge of investigating this matter recently passed away unexpectedly.
choice_prompt:14:1711143012.source_cn: 说起来……当时主要负责调查此事的那一位宫廷魔法师，前不久意外去世了。

say:0:1711144001:0.text: Go to the Department of Magical Affairs and look for information.
say:0:1711144001:0.source_cn: 去魔法事务司那里找找资料吧。

choice_prompt:4:1711145003.text: I can now actually get a full four hours of restful sleep in bed every day! This was simply a luxury a while ago.
choice_prompt:4:1711145003.source_cn: 我现在每天居然能安稳地在床上睡满四个小时了！这在前段时间，简直是奢望。

say:5:1711145004:1.text: Your wisdom saved the entire Department of Affairs!
say:5:1711145004:1.source_cn: 您的智慧拯救了整个事务司！

say:6:1711145006:1.text: Of course, I also owe a lot to Hugh's help. He took on a lot of the miscellaneous tasks of sorting documents for me.
say:6:1711145006:1.source_cn: 当然，这也要多亏了休的帮忙。他帮我分担了大量文书分类的杂务。

choice_prompt:10:1711145008.text: But Lord Merlin is usually so busy, why did you suddenly come today? Is there some troublesome matter outside?
choice_prompt:10:1711145008.source_cn: 不过梅林大人平时那么忙，您今天突然前来，难道是外面又出了什么棘手的事吗？

say:12:1711145010:1.text: The report on the Bantis border... that report was compiled by the late colleague Kraft.
say:12:1711145010:1.source_cn: 班题斯边境的报告……那份报告是由已故的同僚克拉夫特调查整理。

choice_prompt:13:1711145010.text: The report on the Bantis border... that report was compiled by the late colleague Kraft.
choice_prompt:13:1711145010.source_cn: 班题斯边境的报告……那份报告是由已故的同僚克拉夫特调查整理。

say:17:1711145014:1.text: I remember the location! Lord Merlin, please follow me.
say:17:1711145014:1.source_cn: 我记得位置！梅林大人，请跟我来。

choice:10:0:1.text: I'm here to review a report.

choice:4:0:1.text: It seems my efforts weren't in vain.

say:19:1711145005:1.text: Compared to the previous three days when I relied solely on energizing potions to get through it, this is much better.
say:19:1711145005:1.source_cn: 比起之前连续三天只靠提神魔药硬撑，这已经很好了。

choice:4:1:2.text: You've only slept for four hours... You still need to take care of your health.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 才睡四个小时……还要注意身体

say:2:1711146001:1.text: Oh no... that border research report is gone!
say:2:1711146001:1.source_cn: 糟糕……那份边境调研报告不见了！

say:4:1711146003:1.text: Apart from the record that was previously sealed and archived, there is no record of anyone accessing it.
say:4:1711146003:1.source_cn: 除了上次将其封存归档的记录，根本没有任何人取用记录。

choice_prompt:5:1711146003.text: Apart from the record that was previously sealed and archived, there is no record of anyone accessing it.
choice_prompt:5:1711146003.source_cn: 除了上次将其封存归档的记录，根本没有任何人取用记录。

say:7:1711146005:1.text: This is troublesome. We need to cordon off the area! Hugh, go and call Ditz and Dali over right now!
say:7:1711146005:1.source_cn: 这下麻烦了。我们先封锁现场！休，你立刻去把迪兹和达利叫过来！

say:0:1711147001:0.text: Is there going to be another new job?

say:1:1711147002:0.text: Is it time for a break?

say:1:1711148001:1.text: What's wrong, Kirsty? I had already packed my things and was ready to leave work on time...
say:1:1711148001:1.source_cn: 怎么了，科丝蒂？我刚才都已经收拾好东西准备准点下班了……

say:2:1711148002:1.text: Even if the sky falls, shouldn't I be the one to hold it up tomorrow?
say:2:1711148002:1.source_cn: 就算天塌下来，也该让明天的我去顶吧？

say:3:1711148003:1.text: Weren't you here for afternoon tea? I brought pumpkin tarts...
say:3:1711148003:1.source_cn: 不是来吃下午茶的吗？我带了南瓜馅饼……

say:10:1711148008:1.text: Wait a minute! You don't suspect that the two of us did it, do you?!
say:10:1711148008:1.source_cn: 等一下！你们该不会怀疑是我们俩干的吧？！

choice_prompt:11:1711148008.text: Wait a minute! You don't suspect that the two of us did it, do you?!
choice_prompt:11:1711148008.source_cn: 等一下！你们该不会怀疑是我们俩干的吧？！

say:12:1711148009:0.text: Lately, we've been working non-stop from the moment we open our eyes, how could we have time to take this away!
say:12:1711148009:0.source_cn: 最近这段时间，我们两眼一睁就是工作，怎么有时间拿走这个！

say:16:1711148012:1.text: But... what is the purpose of us obtaining this report?
say:16:1711148012:1.source_cn: 可是……我们拿报告的目的是什么呀？

say:19:1711148015:1.text: The report is indeed missing. If it disappeared after being archived, then who...?
say:19:1711148015:1.source_cn: 可报告确实不见了。如果在归档后就不在了，那究竟是谁……

choice_prompt:20:1711148015.text: The report is indeed missing. If it disappeared after being archived, then who...?
choice_prompt:20:1711148015.source_cn: 可报告确实不见了。如果在归档后就不在了，那究竟是谁……

choice_prompt:22:1711148016.text: We cannot rule out the possibility that if he tampered with the documents before they were filed, we would indeed have no way of knowing.
choice_prompt:22:1711148016.source_cn: 不排除这个可能性，如果他在归档之前就动了手脚，我们也确实无法得知。

say:23:1711148017:1.text: It's unlikely. After his accident, the property he lived in was quickly sold by his relatives.
say:23:1711148017:1.source_cn: 不太可能。他出事后，所住的房产很快就被他的亲戚给出售了。

say:24:1711148018:1.text: We attended the funeral, and apart from the coffin already being sealed, there didn't seem to be anything special about it.
say:24:1711148018:1.source_cn: 我们去参加了葬礼，除了已经封棺外，好像也没有什么特别之处。

choice_prompt:25:1711148018.text: We attended the funeral, and apart from the coffin already being sealed, there didn't seem to be anything special about it.
choice_prompt:25:1711148018.source_cn: 我们去参加了葬礼，除了已经封棺外，好像也没有什么特别之处。

say:26:1711148019:1.text: As for anything unusual... apart from the wind being a bit strong in the cemetery, nothing else seems to be wrong.
say:26:1711148019:1.source_cn: 异常嘛……除了墓园的风有点大，好像没别的事。

say:27:1711148020:1.text: Ah, the only thing I remember is that Kraft's tombstone was really elaborate.
say:27:1711148020:1.source_cn: 啊，我唯一有印象的是，克拉夫特的墓碑真的很考究。

say:31:1711148024:1.text: No, Kraft died in an experimental accident!
say:31:1711148024:1.source_cn: 不对，克拉夫特是死于实验意外！

choice_prompt:34:1711148026.text: Oh right! I haven't heard anything about Kraft's achievements in astrology and divination, so how did he figure this out!
choice_prompt:34:1711148026.source_cn: 对哦！也没挺说克拉夫特在占星和占卜上有什么成就，他怎么算得出这个！

say:35:1711148027:1.text: Clearly, Mr. Kraft's "death" was a pre-arranged farewell.
say:35:1711148027:1.source_cn: 很显然，那位克拉夫特先生的“死亡”，是自己提前安排好的谢幕。

choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 这是一场蓄谋已久的骗局

choice:25:0:1.text: Thinking about it carefully, is there really nothing unusual?
choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 仔细想想，真的没什么异常吗？

choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 仔细想想克拉夫特生前的事

choice:22:1:2.text: Is it possible that the report is still at his house?
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 报告有没有可能还在他家里

choice:20:0:1.text: Perhaps it disappeared before it was even archived.
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 或许，在归档前就不见了

choice:11:0:1.text: You have a chance to take it while things are in chaos
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 你们有机会趁乱拿走它

choice:11:1:2.text: Perhaps it was you who stole the classified report?
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 或许，就是你们偷拿了机密报告？

say:1:1711149412:0.text: All of this points to the same absurd truth.
say:1:1711149412:0.source_cn: 这一切的背后，都指向了同一个荒谬的真相。

say:7:1711149027:1.text: He's incredibly audacious to hide in a cemetery...
say:7:1711149027:1.source_cn: 他实在太大胆了，居然敢藏在墓地里……

say:8:1711149028:1.text: ...Oh no, did that mean all the things I said to him in the cemetery last time were heard by this dead man?!
say:8:1711149028:1.source_cn: ……糟糕，那我上次在墓园骂他的话，岂不是全被这个死人听见了！

choice_prompt:12:1711149030.text: Of course, please wait here a moment, Lord Merlin. Costie and I will head to the cemetery now and bring him back!
choice_prompt:12:1711149030.source_cn: 当然，请梅林大人在这里稍作等候。我和科丝蒂这就前往墓园，把他抓回来！

say:13:1711149031:1.text: We'll be careful! Kirsty, let's go!
say:13:1711149031:1.source_cn: 我们会注意的！科丝蒂，我们走！

choice:12:1:2.text: He might have a backup plan.

say:2:1711149402:0.text: You conveyed the contents of the will to the court magicians, who each discovered suspicious points.
say:2:1711149402:0.source_cn: 你将遗嘱上的内容转达给了宫廷魔法师们，他们也各自发现了疑点。

say:4:1711149403:1.text: This will is somewhat illogical and temporally inconsistent...
say:4:1711149403:1.source_cn: 这遗嘱在逻辑和时态上有些说不通……

say:9:1711149407:1.text: Wait a minute! Cake! Wine! I knew something was off!
say:9:1711149407:1.source_cn: 等等！蛋糕！葡萄酒！我刚才就觉得哪里不对劲！

say:11:1711149409:1.text: It's like... someone meticulously maintains and "feeds" it every day!
say:11:1711149409:1.source_cn: 就好像……每天都有人去精心维护和“进食”一样！

say:13:1711149410:1.text: You list all the doubts surrounding Kraft's "death" in your mind...
say:13:1711149410:1.source_cn: 你将关于克拉夫特“死亡”的疑点在脑海中全部列出……

say:1:1711152001:1.text: Lord Merlin, we have brought Kraft back.
say:1:1711152001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我们把克拉夫特抓回来了。

say:5:1711152004:1.text: I am just an ordinary landscape consultant employed by the cemetery management office.
say:5:1711152004:1.source_cn: 我只是一位受雇于墓园管理处的，普通的园艺景观顾问。

choice_prompt:7:1711152005.text: As for the "Crawford magician who died young" you mentioned, my resemblance to him was just Aya's joke.
choice_prompt:7:1711152005.source_cn: 至于你们口中那位“英年早逝的克拉夫特魔法师”，我与他容貌上的相似只是艾雅的玩笑罢了。

say:8:1711152006:1.text: Your Excellency, I do not understand what you mean.

say:11:1711152009:1.text: Simply request to use a mantra array on you once, or verify your magic registration information—
say:11:1711152009:1.source_cn: 只要申请对你使用一次真言法阵，或者核对你的魔力登记信息——

say:12:1711152010:1.text: Sigh, why resort to such crude methods? What difference would it make if I admitted it?
say:12:1711152010:1.source_cn: 唉，何必动用那种粗鲁的手段呢？我即使承认了又有什么关系？

say:13:1711152011:1.text: I only took some "expedient measures" to avoid the recent political turmoil.
say:13:1711152011:1.source_cn: 我只是为了规避前阵子的政治动荡，而采取了一些“权宜之计”。

choice_prompt:14:1711152011.text: I only took some "expedient measures" to avoid the recent political turmoil.
choice_prompt:14:1711152011.source_cn: 我只是为了规避前阵子的政治动荡，而采取了一些“权宜之计”。

say:15:1711152012:1.text: ...Thanks to you, Lord Merlin. The environment there is indeed very beneficial for mana recovery.
say:15:1711152012:1.source_cn: ……托您的福，梅林阁下。那里的环境确实对魔力恢复大有裨益。

say:16:1711152014:1.text: Is the "Bantis Border Survey Report" also your expedient measure?
say:16:1711152014:1.source_cn: 《班题斯边境调研报告》，也是你的权宜之计吗？

say:17:1711152015:1.text: Of course. After Lord Dilgrey's accident, the Affairs Department was in complete chaos.
say:17:1711152015:1.source_cn: 当然。迪尔格雷大人出事后，事务司一片混乱。

choice_prompt:20:1711152016.text: As a seasoned magician, I should move the confidential report to a safer location for proper storage. This is a wise move to prevent any potential problems.
choice_prompt:20:1711152016.source_cn: 作为资深魔法师，我理应将机密报告转移到更安全的地方妥善保管。这是防患于未然的明智之举。

say:21:1711152017:1.text: You ignored Kraft's platitudes and instead threw out your trump card.
say:21:1711152017:1.source_cn: 你懒得理克拉夫特的套话理由，而是直接抛出了致命底牌。

say:23:1711152019:1.text: Oh, Lord Merlin, you must have been misled by some false rumors.
say:23:1711152019:1.source_cn: 哦，梅林阁下，您一定是被某些不实的流言误导了。

say:24:1711152020:1.text: As a subordinate, my relationship with former Chief Executive Officer Deergray was merely that of a superior and subordinate.
say:24:1711152020:1.source_cn: 作为下属，我与迪尔格雷前首席之间，仅仅维持着上下级关系。

say:27:1711152022:1.text: If you were unaware of the situation, why did you immediately fake your death to escape after Deer Grey's accident?
say:27:1711152022:1.source_cn: 如果你不知情，迪尔格雷出事后，你为什么要立刻假死脱身？

say:29:1711152024:1.text: Save your arguments for the judge!
say:29:1711152024:1.source_cn: 你的这些说辞，留着跟法官说吧！

choice_prompt:32:1711152025.text: Conviction requires solid evidence and witness testimony! This person I've never met before—let me call him a magician for now—don't try to intimidate a respected senior with a few laws!
choice_prompt:32:1711152025.source_cn: 定罪是需要确凿的人证物证的！这位从没见过的，我姑且成为魔法师吧。你别妄图拿着几条律法，就来恐吓一位有资历的前辈！

choice_prompt:38:1711152030.text: For example, the "Bantis Border Survey Report" that you've been investigating. Dillgreat's original instruction was for me to destroy it completely.
choice_prompt:38:1711152030.source_cn: 比如你们一直追查的那份《班题斯边境调研报告》。迪尔格雷原本的指令，是让我将它彻底销毁。

say:39:1711152031:1.text: I have no idea about that, after all, it's a report that I painstakingly researched and wrote.
say:39:1711152031:1.source_cn: 这我就不得而知了，毕竟这也是我辛辛苦苦调研写出的报告。

say:40:1711152032:1.text: So... I didn't destroy it, but kept it with me.
say:40:1711152032:1.source_cn: 所以……我并没有销毁它，而是把它留在了身边。

choice_prompt:41:1711152032.text: So... I didn't destroy it, but kept it with me.
choice_prompt:41:1711152032.source_cn: 所以……我并没有销毁它，而是把它留在了身边。

say:42:1711152033:1.text: It was in that guardhouse hut, hidden in a secret compartment under the floorboards.
say:42:1711152033:1.source_cn: 就在那栋看守小屋里，藏在地板下面的暗格中。

say:44:1711152035:1.text: Or perhaps they simply assist in magical experiments or take notes.
say:44:1711152035:1.source_cn: 或者在某些魔法实验中打打下手、做做记录而已。

choice_prompt:46:1711152036.text: I assure you, Your Excellency Merlin, these are merely insignificant peripheral tasks, and certainly not serious crimes.
choice_prompt:46:1711152036.source_cn: 我向您保证，梅林阁下，这些都只是些无关痛痒的边缘工作，绝对算不上什么严重的罪行。

say:51:1711152040:1.text: Lord Merlin! Since the report is in the guardhouse, please allow me to go there and look for it!
say:51:1711152040:1.source_cn: 梅林大人！既然报告就在看守小屋，请允许我去那里寻找！

choice_prompt:52:1711152040.text: Lord Merlin! Since the report is in the guardhouse, please allow me to go there and look for it!
choice_prompt:52:1711152040.source_cn: 梅林大人！既然报告就在看守小屋，请允许我去那里寻找！

say:53:1711152041:1.text: Lord Merlin, let's go to the secret chamber now... Dillgret's secret chamber...
say:53:1711152041:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，那我们现在过去密室吧……迪尔格雷的密室……

choice:46:1:2.text: What you've actually done is probably much more than that.
choice:46:1:2.source_cn: 你实际做的，应该远不止这些吧

choice:32:0:1.text: Since you won't tell me, then I'll have no choice but to hand you over to Eve.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 既然你不肯说，那就只能把你交给伊芙

choice:32:1:2.text: Either tell the truth, or you'll spend your life in prison.
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 要么说实话，要么你就蹲一辈子监狱吧

choice:20:1:2.text: You're keeping this to cover up evidence, aren't you?
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 你的保管是为了掩盖罪证吧

choice:14:0:1.text: You've managed to "avoid" it quite well.

say:56:1711152013:1.text: Time was of the essence, so I didn't do anything unnecessary.
say:56:1711152013:1.source_cn: 时间紧迫，我并没有做什么多余的事情。

choice:14:1:2.text: You're not just avoiding it, are you?

choice:7:0:1.text: You're just putting up a last-ditch effort.
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 你现在只是在负隅顽抗

say:57:1711152007:1.text: First of all, I am not Kraft. Secondly, your sarcasm is a bit rude.
say:57:1711152007:1.source_cn: 首先，我不是克拉夫特。其次，您的讽刺有点失礼。

choice:7:1:2.text: You died with a rosy complexion, Mr. Kraft.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你“死”得面色红润啊，克拉夫特先生

choice_prompt:2:1711153001.text: Wait, wait! Lord Merlin! Mage Costi, I've told you everything I know... Why did you bring me here?!
choice_prompt:2:1711153001.source_cn: 等、等等！梅林阁下！科斯蒂魔法师，我已经把知道的都说了……你们为什么要把我带到这里？！

say:4:1711153003:1.text: Finally, there's that unfinished thesis that involves Orion, Germwen, and you...
say:4:1711153003:1.source_cn: 最后，是那牵扯到奥利安、格墨文和你的未完成论文……

choice_prompt:6:1711153004.text: These are just routine external resource coordination... I was only responsible for liaison; I absolutely did not participate in those crazy experiments!
choice_prompt:6:1711153004.source_cn: 这、 这些只是常规的外部资源统筹……我只负责对接，我绝对没有参与那些疯狂的实验！

say:9:1711153007:1.text: No! I didn't kill Emerson! Lord Merlin, I swear!
say:9:1711153007:1.source_cn: 不！我没有杀埃摩森！梅林大人，我发誓！

say:12:1711153010:1.text: If I don't do as instructed, I'll be the experimental subject!
say:12:1711153010:1.source_cn: 如果我不照做，实验材料就会是我！

say:14:1711153011:1.text: Coward. You just stand by and watch your colleague's magic be drained, all to keep your own position?
say:14:1711153011:1.source_cn: 懦夫。你为了保住自己的位置，就眼睁睁看着同僚被抽干魔力？

choice_prompt:15:1711153011.text: Coward. You just stand by and watch your colleague's magic be drained, all to keep your own position?
choice_prompt:15:1711153011.source_cn: 懦夫。你为了保住自己的位置，就眼睁睁看着同僚被抽干魔力？

say:16:1711153012:1.text: I... I still have something to say! Lord Merlin!
say:16:1711153012:1.source_cn: 我、我还有东西可以交代！梅林大人！

choice:15:0:1.text: This known intelligence is not enough.

choice:15:1:2.text: If this is all the value you have...
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 如果这是你全部的价值……

choice:6:0:1.text: Is Emerson's death really unrelated to you?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 埃摩森的死真的与你无关？

choice:6:1:2.text: You dare say you don't know about Deergray's research?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你敢说你不知道迪尔格雷的研究？

choice:2:0:1.text: Your testimony is full of loopholes.

choice:2:1:2.text: Don't be nervous, we're helping you remember more.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 别紧张，我们在帮助你回忆更多

choice:2:2:3.text: Stop spouting your lies about not knowing the truth.
choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 收起你不知情的鬼话吧

say:0:1711154001:0.text: This is it... Please allow me to break the special seal.
say:0:1711154001:0.source_cn: 就是这里……请容我解开特殊的封印。

say:1:1711154002:0.text: Alright... Lord Merlin, please open it.
say:1:1711154002:0.source_cn: 好了……梅林大人，请打开吧。

say:5:1711155003:0.text: Deergray was a madman, but his research in this area has inspired you.
say:5:1711155003:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷是个疯子，但他在这方面的研究也启发了你。

say:9:1711155006:1.text: Merlin, the Mage... Kirsty the Magician...
say:9:1711155006:1.source_cn: 梅、梅林阁下……科丝蒂魔法师……

say:10:1711155007:1.text: I have revealed to you all of Deer Grey's most crucial secrets without reservation!
say:10:1711155007:1.source_cn: 我、我已经毫无保留地将迪尔格雷最核心的机密都展示给你们了！

say:18:1711155012:0.text: Praise be to Aya… Praise be to your boundless mercy, Lord Merlin…
say:18:1711155012:0.source_cn: 赞美艾雅……赞美您宽宏大量的慈悲，梅林阁下……

say:0:1711156001:0.text: Lord Merlin! Kirsty! I've found her!
say:0:1711156001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人！科丝蒂！我找到了！

choice_prompt:2:1711157001.text: Just as Kraft had confessed, the report was hidden in a secret compartment under the floorboards of the guard's cabin! It took me three whole planks to dig it out!
choice_prompt:2:1711157001.source_cn: 就像克拉夫特交代的那样，报告就藏在看守小屋地板下的暗格里！我足足拆了三块木板才把它挖出来！

say:3:1711157002:1.text: Hehe. This is the stolen "Bantis Border Survey Report".
say:3:1711157002:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿。这就是那份失窃的《班题斯边境调研报告》。

say:6:1711157004:0.text: You recall the location of Aya's disappearance and the report that Dilgrey insisted on destroying...
say:6:1711157004:0.source_cn: 你回忆起之前艾雅的失踪地，与迪尔格雷执意要销毁的报告……

say:10:1711157006:1.text: I can't believe... that such primitive and dangerous witchcraft still exists in the world?
say:10:1711157006:1.source_cn: 真不敢相信……世间竟然还有如此原始又危险的巫术？

say:12:1711157008:1.text: Kirsty, the academic books you've studied are too orthodox.
say:12:1711157008:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂，你学的那些学院派理论书籍还是太正统了。

say:13:1711157009:1.text: It's common for some audacious forces along the border to specialize in this kind of business.
say:13:1711157009:1.source_cn: 边境上有些胆大包天的势力，专门做这种生意，也是常事。

say:14:1711157010:1.text: Even if it's to go to the territory of the undead?

say:15:1711157011:1.text: People die for money. However, there's one thing I don't quite understand.
say:15:1711157011:1.source_cn: 人为财死。不过，我有一点不太理解。

choice_prompt:18:1711157013.text: Is it because it mentions "certain chambers of commerce"? What is Deergray covering up for the Black Gold Chamber of Commerce?
choice_prompt:18:1711157013.source_cn: 是因为里面提到了“某些商会”？迪尔格雷在为黑金商会掩盖些什么？

say:19:1711157014:1.text: You're going to Bandis?! Lord Merlin! That's too dangerous!
say:19:1711157014:1.source_cn: 您要去班题斯？！梅林大人！这太危险了！

say:20:1711157015:0.text: Lord Merlin, the situation in the capital has not yet been completely resolved. Why do you suddenly want to go to a place like that?
say:20:1711157015:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，王都的事情还没彻底平息，您为什么突然要去那种地方？

choice_prompt:21:1711157015.text: Lord Merlin, the situation in the capital has not yet been completely resolved. Why do you suddenly want to go to a place like that?
choice_prompt:21:1711157015.source_cn: 梅林大人，王都的事情还没彻底平息，您为什么突然要去那种地方？

choice_prompt:24:1711157019.text: You didn't tell them any clues about Aya's disappearance in Bandis. This matter involves many factions, and the less they know, the safer it will be for these two young mages.
choice_prompt:24:1711157019.source_cn: 你并没有告诉他们艾雅在班题斯失踪的线索。这件事牵扯到了诸多势力，知道得越少，对这两个年轻的魔法师来说就越安全。

say:25:1711157020:0.text: In that case, please be extremely careful!
say:25:1711157020:0.source_cn: 既然如此，请您务必万分小心！

say:26:1711157021:1.source_cn: 祝您一切顺利，梅林大人。

choice:24:0:1.text: Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.

choice:24:1:2.text: This report was a great help.

choice:24:2:3.text: I'll set off once I've dealt with the remaining few tricky matters.
choice:24:2:3.source_cn: 等我把剩下的几件棘手事处理完，就会动身

choice:21:0:1.text: There are reasons why you absolutely must go.

say:29:1711157018:0.text: ...Why does this sound like a joke to me?
say:29:1711157018:0.source_cn: ……怎么我听着完全不像玩笑呢？

choice:21:1:2.text: Because I haven't been there yet.

choice:18:0:1.text: Once I go to Bandis myself, I'll understand.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 等我亲自去一趟班题斯，自然就清楚了

say:1:1711159001:1.text: Merlin, all the preparations are complete, and we can begin at any time.
say:1:1711159001:1.source_cn: 梅林，该做的准备都已就绪，我们随时都可以开始。

say:5:1711159005:1.text: Merlin, you don't need to try to persuade me anymore. I am willing to bear all the consequences and will never regret it.
say:5:1711159005:1.source_cn: 梅林，你不必再劝我。我自愿承担一切后果，绝不后悔。

say:7:1711159007:1.text: Let's get started. I'm more clear-headed than ever.
say:7:1711159007:1.source_cn: 动手吧，我比任何时候都清醒。

choice_prompt:8:1711159007.text: Let's get started. I'm more clear-headed than ever.
choice_prompt:8:1711159007.source_cn: 动手吧，我比任何时候都清醒。

say:11:1711159011:1.text: I did not obtain their consent, nor did I intend to discuss it with them beforehand.
say:11:1711159011:1.source_cn: 我没有征得他们的同意，也不打算在事前商量。

say:13:1711159013:1.text: In this room, there is only you, me, and this realization.
say:13:1711159013:1.source_cn: 在这个房间里，只有你，和我，以及这份觉悟。

say:14:1711159014:1.text: You look at her quietly and suddenly bring up the agreement you made when you were researching Deergray's paper.
say:14:1711159014:1.source_cn: 你静静地看着她，突然提到了你们研究迪尔格雷论文时的约定。

say:15:1711159015:1.text: You've won, so she needs to grant you one request.
say:15:1711159015:1.source_cn: 你胜利了，所以她需要答应你一件事。

say:16:1711159016:1.text: Tell me anything I can give, Merlin.
say:16:1711159016:1.source_cn: 只要是我能给的，请讲，梅林。

choice_prompt:19:1711159018.text: Why? What's the point of telling them the truth other than making them feel guilty towards me?
choice_prompt:19:1711159018.source_cn: 为什么？告诉他们真相，除了让他们背负着对我的内疚，还有什么意义？

say:22:1711159021:1.text: ...I understand. If I were still sober, I would tell them myself.
say:22:1711159021:1.source_cn: ……我懂了。如果我还清醒着，我会亲口告诉他们。

say:23:1711159022:1.text: To ease the tension, you brought up another matter.
say:23:1711159022:1.source_cn: 为了缓和气氛，你主动提起了另一件事。

say:25:1711159024:1.text: Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on it. I can't let someone without magic occupy Gawain's seat for too long.
say:25:1711159024:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我会留意的。可不能让失去魔力的我占据高文席位太久。

choice_prompt:26:1711159024.text: Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on it. I can't let someone without magic occupy Gawain's seat for too long.
choice_prompt:26:1711159024.source_cn: 放心吧，我会留意的。可不能让失去魔力的我占据高文席位太久。

say:27:1711159025:1.text: Thank you for your help, Chief Merlin.

choice:26:0:1.text: Let's go to Deer Grey's secret chamber.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们去迪尔格雷的密室吧

choice:26:1:2.text: It's time to put that magic circle to a new purpose.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 是时候让那个法阵发挥新的作用了

choice:19:0:1.text: Because they have the right to know

choice:19:1:2.text: They need to know what you've given.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 他们得知道你付出了什么

choice:8:0:1.text: Would Peggy agree to you doing this?
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 佩吉会同意你这么做吗？

choice:8:1:2.text: Will Maxim agree when he wakes up?
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 马克西姆醒来后，他会赞同吗？

say:2:1711162003:1.text: Until it all entered her eyes...
say:2:1711162003:1.source_cn: 直至悉数钻进了她的眼中……

say:0:1711163001:0.text: Modlyn, let me see your eyes!
say:0:1711163001:0.source_cn: 莫德琳，让我看看你的眼睛！

say:2:1711164003:1.text: Therefore, due to the limitations of the underlying rules of reversal magic, the ultimate price Mordrine paid was—
say:2:1711164003:1.source_cn: 所以，基于逆转魔法底层规则的限制，莫德琳承担的最终代价是——

say:5:1711164005:1.text: No need to waste your energy on me anymore. I'm already prepared to accept all of this.
say:5:1711164005:1.source_cn: 不用……再为我白费力气了。我早就准备好了……接受这一切。

say:1:1711166001:1.text: I think I had a very long dream.
say:1:1711166001:1.source_cn: 我好像……做了一个很漫长的梦。

say:2:1711166002:1.text: In my dream, I kept falling into an endless black fog.
say:2:1711166002:1.source_cn: 梦中，我一直在一片无边无际的黑雾里不断坠落。

say:4:1711166004:1.text: Am I still dreaming at this moment?
say:4:1711166004:1.source_cn: 此时此刻，我仍在梦中吗？

say:6:1711166005:1.text: No… Maxim, this isn’t a dream. Hold my hand tightly, feel it.
say:6:1711166005:1.source_cn: 不……马克西姆，这不是梦。握紧我的手，感受它。

say:7:1711166006:1.text: Why are your hands so cold?

say:9:1711166008:1.text: But this warmth, this touch, are all real. I pulled you back from the darkness.
say:9:1711166008:1.source_cn: 但这份温度，这份触感，皆为真实。我把你从黑雾里拉回来了。

say:10:1711166009:1.text: This isn't the place to talk, Maxim. Let's go back to your quarters first.
say:10:1711166009:1.source_cn: 这里也不是说话的地方，马克西姆，我们先回你的寝殿吧。

say:11:1711166010:1.text: You have just woken up and your body still needs rest.
say:11:1711166010:1.source_cn: 你刚刚苏醒，身体依然需要休息。

say:3:1711167002:1.text: Aya's blessing, Maxim, you finally pulled through.
say:3:1711167002:1.source_cn: 艾雅眷顾，马克西姆，你终于挺过来了。

say:4:1711167003:1.text: This isn't just the mercy of the Holy Light, is it? Merlin, and you too... Mordrine.
say:4:1711167003:1.source_cn: 这不仅仅是圣光的仁慈吧？梅林，还有你……莫德琳。

choice_prompt:8:1711167006.text: Merlin, could you please double-check on Maxim's health? I only trust your judgment.
choice_prompt:8:1711167006.source_cn: 梅林，能劳烦你再确认一下马克西姆的身体状况吗？我只相信你的判断。

choice_prompt:14:1711167010.text: Although I don't know what efforts you've made, Merlin, please accept my sincerest gratitude.
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.source_cn: 虽然不知道你们付出了怎样的努力，但是，梅林，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。

say:15:1711167011:1.text: You have saved the Empire time and time again, and you have saved me. You are the closest friend of the Radiant Royal Family.
say:15:1711167011:1.source_cn: 你一次次拯救了帝国，拯救了我，你是耀光王室最亲密的朋友。

say:17:1711167015:1.text: You've worked hard these past few years.

say:18:1711167016:1.text: But before that, I'd like to see Orion and Peggy—
say:18:1711167016:1.source_cn: 不过，在那之前，我想见见奥利安和佩吉——

say:20:1711167012:1.text: Mordrine... I can sense that you've done something extremely dangerous behind my back.
say:20:1711167012:1.source_cn: 莫德琳……我能感觉到，你瞒着我做了一件极其危险的事。

say:21:1711167013:1.text: ...I will tell you and Peggy everything exactly as it is, I promise.
say:21:1711167013:1.source_cn: ……我会把一切都原原本本地告诉你和佩吉的，我保证。

choice:14:1:2.text: You should thank Moderin the most.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 你最该感谢的是莫德琳

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711129001:.text: Looks like they're not here...wait, what?!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711137101:.text: As you can see, this is it.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1711168004:.text: I've been waiting for this day...
